title: HR Professional - Intern
description:
**Introduction**
As an
**HR Professional**
, you will contribute to delivering effective Human Resources solutions and support business and employee needs. You will work collaboratively with HR and business stakeholders to understand requirements, analyze information, support HR processes, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
  
  
This role provides an opportunity to develop broad HR expertise while leveraging data, technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools to improve the employee and stakeholder experience.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
**Analytical Problem Solving :**

* Apply analytical thinking to understand HR-related issues and identify appropriate solutions with guidance when required.
* Analyze HR data and information to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for improvement.
* Support the preparation of reports, presentations, and analyses for HR and business stakeholders.
* Document and refine existing HR processes and workflows to improve efficiency and consistency.
* Identify opportunities to simplify routine HR activities and improve the overall employee and stakeholder experience.
* Explore and support the use of automation, digital solutions, and AI-enabled tools to improve HR processes and productivity.

**Autonomy And Impact To The Organization**

* Take ownership of assigned HR activities and deliver outcomes within defined timelines.
* Work independently on routine activities while seeking guidance for complex or unfamiliar situations.
* Apply judgment and available information to recommend solutions and support decision-making.
* Contribute ideas and individual expertise toward team and organizational goals.
* Develop an understanding of IBM's business, industry, workforce, and HR practices.
* Participate in HR projects and continuous improvement initiatives that contribute to business and employee outcomes.

**Skills And Collaboration**

* Collaborate effectively with HR colleagues, business stakeholders, employees, and cross-functional teams.
* Communicate clearly and professionally through written and verbal communication.
* Build positive working relationships through transparency, professionalism, and effective collaboration.
* Research HR practices and contribute ideas, insights, reports, and analyses to support team objectives.
* Demonstrate willingness to learn and develop professional HR expertise.
* Leverage collaboration, analytics, digital, and AI-driven technologies to enhance HR effectiveness.
* Support team members and contribute to knowledge sharing and a collaborative work environment.

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
**Role 1 : HR Transformation Professional – Product Management**
As an HR Transformation Professional, you will play the role of a Product Manager for HR solutions, shaping digital products that impact employees across the organization.
  
  
You will work closely with business leaders, users, designers, and engineering teams to identify opportunities, define product requirements, prioritize features, and drive the product roadmap from concept to implementation. Leveraging data, AI, automation, and design thinking, you will solve complex workforce challenges and build scalable solutions that create measurable business impact.
  
  
This role is ideal for individuals passionate about product management, technology, innovation, and strategic problem-solving in HR.
  
  
**Role 2**
:
**HR Business Development Professional**
As an HR Business Development Professional, you will work on strategic business transformation initiatives including outsourcing, acquisitions, divestitures, and workforce integration programs. Partnering with clients, business leaders, and HR teams, you will help assess workforce impacts, develop people-focused solutions, manage transition activities, and support business deals from planning through execution. This role is ideal for individuals who enjoy consulting, stakeholder engagement, project management, business analysis, and solving complex organizational challenges at the intersection of people and business strategy
  
  
This role is well-suited for candidates who are passionate about consulting, business transformation, M&A, organizational strategy, and stakeholder engagement.
  
  
**Role 3: HR Compensation Professional**
As a Compensation Professional, you will help shape how IBM attracts, motivates, and retains talent through compensation, rewards, and recognition programs. Working with business leaders, HR, and Finance teams, you will leverage data, market insights, and analytics to evaluate pay practices, benchmark talent, support salary planning, and make evidence-based recommendations that align business goals with employee experience. This role involves data, solving complex business problems, influencing workforce decisions, and understanding how compensation strategy drives organizational success
  
  
Individuals who are interested in leveraging analytics, market intelligence, and business acumen to shape compensation strategies, support workforce decisions, and drive organizational performance through evidence-based insight
  
  
**Role 4 : AI Product Manager – HR Innovation Professional**
As an
**AI Product Manager - HR**
, you will help shape the future of work by designing and delivering AI-powered solutions that transform employee and HR experiences. Working at the intersection of business, technology, data, and automation, you will identify opportunities for innovation, define product requirements, and partner with cross-functional teams to build and scale digital workers, intelligent workflows, and AI-enabled products.
  
  
Individuals with a strong interest in product management, AI, emerging technologies, digital transformation, and data-driven problem solving, who aspire to build innovative solutions that create business impact at scale.
  
  
**Role 5 : HR- Talent Professional – Learning, Leadership & Skills**
As a Talent Professional in HR, you will help shape how IBM develops skills, leaders, and careers in an AI-enabled world. Working across learning, leadership development, skills, and career programs, you will use data, AI, design thinking, and workforce insights to create scalable solutions that help employees learn, grow, and succeed. You will contribute to talent initiatives, analyze workforce trends, build innovative employee experiences, and partner with stakeholders to solve future workforce challenges.
  
  
Role requires strong interest in talent development, learning, workforce skills, leadership, employee experience, and the application of AI and data to solve people and business challenges at scale
  
  
**Role 6 : HR Learning Consultant – Workforce Skills & Capability Development**
As a Learning Consultant, you will partner with business leaders to identify skill gaps and design learning solutions that build critical workforce capabilities. You will translate business priorities into targeted learning strategies, manage the delivery of large-scale upskilling and reskilling programs, and collaborate with global stakeholders to ensure employees have the skills needed for future success. This role combines stakeholder consulting, program management, workforce development, and learning strategy to drive business transformation through continuous learning.
  
  
Individuals with a strong interest in learning, workforce development, stakeholder consulting, program management, and skills transformation, who are motivated by creating large-scale impact through capability building and employee growth
  
  
**Critical Skills For Success**

* Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related discipline.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
* Ability to learn new processes, technologies, and HR tools quickly.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* Demonstrated interest in Human Resources and business operations.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Up-to 1 year of industry work experience
* Experience in AI-related academic projects at the undergraduate and/or postgraduate level.
* Academic projects, internships, coursework, or other exposure to Human Resources or business-related activities.
* Exposure to data analysis, reporting, or process improvement.
* Familiarity with HR technology, digital tools, automation, or AI-enabled solutions.
* Ability to adapt to a fast-paced and dynamic work environment.
* Strong learning agility, ownership mindset, and willingness to take on new challenges.

title: Head of HR – India/APAC
description:
Atyeti is a business and technology global consulting firm with deep expertise across BFSI, digital engineering, data & AI, cloud, and enterprise technology solutions. As we continue to scale globally, we are strengthening our people function to support the next phase of growth. We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Head of HR – India/APAC who can partner closely with leadership to shape culture, strengthen organizational capability and help evolve HR into a high-impact strategic business partner function.

**What This Role Will Own:**

**1. Strategic Business Partnering / Advisory**

* Have strong business acumen to understand goals and challenges
* Partner with senior business leaders to define and execute people strategies that align with business objectives

**2. Culture & Employee Experience**

* Build a people-centric, high-performance culture that aligns with business strategy
* Design and execute high-impact employee initiatives, town halls, and team activities to drive connection and belonging
* Lead employee relations matters, including employee grievances, and navigate them with cultural awareness
* Drive internal and external brand reputation by showcasing company life
* Use feedback from surveys and HR analytics to improve retention and engagement

**3. Performance management and Career Pathing (Analytics-Driven)**

* Design and implement frameworks that align employee development with business goals
* Build structured, transparent career pathways for all roles
* Leverage people analytics and business data to guide data-driven workforce planning, predict skills gaps, and make talent decisions that inform leadership reviews and identify flight risks

**4. Talent Management & Development**

* Align workforce planning with business growth, including succession planning and competency mapping
* Drive capability-building initiatives, training, and professional development programs to foster a high-performance culture
* Strengthen hiring frameworks and managing Employer Value Proposition (EVP) for quality talent attraction

**5. Compensation & Benefits**

* Develop and implement compensation structures (bonus plans) and benefits policies to attract and retain top talent
* Conduct annual market surveys, analyse peer data, and use consultants to maintain competitive compensation positioning
* Provide data-driven insights on compensation trends to leadership

**6. HR Operations, Governance & Analytics**

* Design and implement HR policies, ensure compliance with Indian labor laws (POSH, CLRA, PF, ESI, etc.), and mitigate risks
* Maintain global standards and lead employee lifecycle management (onboarding to offboarding)
* Bring HR analytics mindset and drive to forecast attrition, shape strategy and continuously improve employee experience

**7. HR Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor the India HRBP team, fostering a culture of excellence and innovation

**What We’re Looking For:**

* 10+ years of HR experience, preferably within IT Services & Consulting environment
* Strong experience in HR business partnering, organizational transformation, and stakeholder management
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and drive change in fast-paced environments.
* Exposure to organization effectiveness, talent strategy, leadership development, and workforce planning
* Sound understanding of Indian labor laws and HR governance
* Strong business acumen, data orientation, and ability to balance strategy with execution
* Experience working in scaling and evolving organizations is highly preferred

title: Workforce Relations Lead Consultant -
description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Workforce Relations Lead Consultant provides expert guidance on complex workforce relations matters, ensuring compliance with employment laws and organizational policies to drive a positive, high-performing workplace culture. This role independently investigates complex allegations of discrimination and harassment while also advising and influencing leaders, agents, and employees to resolve complex workplace conflicts. This role serves as a trusted advisor within the organization, addressing critical workforce relations issues and initiatives. Additionally, this role partners with Organizational Talent Advisors (OTAs) and HR’s Centers of Excellence (COEs) as subject matter experts, representing the workforce relations function, for HR programs and products. This role may also serve as a primary point of contact for Workforce Transition processes from the initial coaching and counseling of potential business case submissions to executing written employee notifications. This role is responsible for training, leading critical programs, and designing and implementing special projects.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyze employee relations trends and provide recommendations on complex workforce relations matters to drive a high-performing workplace culture
* Collaborate with legal, OTAs, and HR COEs to assess and mitigate risks associated with complex workforce relations matters
* Support organizational change initiatives by owning the workforce transition process, providing insights and guidance on employee transitions and impacts
* Utilize evidence-based communication/storytelling to advise resolution of complex workforce relation matters by presenting data-driven recommendations for all audiences
* Independently manage a large volume of complex workforce relations cases including, but not limited to, investigations of harassment, discrimination, inappropriate conduct, and performance management concerns, with adherence to communicated documentation expectations and service level agreements (SLAs)
* Advise on and support disciplinary actions, terminations, and other employment decisions to ensure consistency and fairness in alignment with local, federal, and international laws and company policies and practices
* Provide expert consultation to leaders, agents, and employees on a wide range of complex workforce relations issues, including performance management, conflict resolution, and workplace investigations

**Education**

* 4 year Bachelors Degree (Preferred)

**Experience**

* Total of 10-15 yrs of experience with atleast 5-6 Yrs in ER role

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* This job does not have supervisory duties.

**Education & Experience (in Lieu)**

* In lieu of the above education requirements, an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

**Primary Skills**
Employee Relations
  
  
**Shift Time**
**Recruiter Info**
Shilpa Amit Vaish
  
  
ShilpaAmit.Vaish@allstate.com
  
  
**About Allstate**
**Joining our team isn’t just a job — it’s an opportunity. One that takes your skills and pushes them to the next level. One that encourages you to challenge the status quo. One where you can shape the future of protection while supporting causes that mean the most to you. Joining our team means being part of something bigger – a winning team making a meaningful impact.**
The Allstate Corporation is one of the largest publicly held insurance providers in the United States. Ranked No. 84 in the 2023 Fortune 500 list of the largest United States corporations by total revenue, The Allstate Corporation owns and operates 18 companies in the United States, Canada, Northern Ireland, and India. title: Senior Team Leader - Human Resources
description:
**Senior Team Leader - Human Resources, India**

**Pune, India · Work from office · Leads a team of Junior HR Generalists**

**About CloudLex**

CloudLex is a leading cloud based legal technology platform for litigation firms in the United States. Headquartered in New York, with engineering, product, and marketing in Pune, India. Reaching 300 professionals globally. Backed by prestigious venture capital and growth private equity, including Aligned Capital, Rosepark Advisors, and The Riverside Company.

**We run two centers in India. The technology division is in Pune., MH. The services division is in Jabalpur, MP. This role covers both. ~100 in Pune and ~200 in Jabalpur.**

**Your Role**

**Run recruitment for both divisions**

* Plan roles and budget with the business leaders in tech and services dvision
* Manage the entirerecruitment process from sourcing to onboardig
* Run the offer stage: negotiate, issue the letter, start background verification, and close
* Manage recruitment consultants where you use them, including fees and quality

**Run campus recruitment for Pune and Jabalpur**

* Build and maintain the list of target institutes for both cities, with a named contact at each
* Call and visit placement officers, and build the relationship before you need the slot
* Negotiate placement dates and slots, and get on the calendar early enough to matter
* Organize pre-placement talks end to end, including panel, travel, material, and logistics
* Run the on-campus test and interview process on the day
* Run the internship program operationally, from intake through the pre-placement offer decision
* Organize hackathons and campus events, including budget, vendors, and the people who will attend

**Lead a team of HR Generalists**

* Set weekly priorities and run a weekly review on open positions
* Coach them on screening, on closing candidates, and on the conversations they find hard
* Review their work rather than assume it, especially on offer letters and candidate communication
* Spend time at Jabalpur Service Center in person on a regular basis, including short stints. The company pays for it

**Run the employee lifecycle**

* Run onboarding: documentation, induction schedule, asset and system access coordinated with IT, and a first week that is planned before the person arrives
* Run the appraisal cycle end to end: calendar, forms, manager chasing, normalization discussions, and letters out on schedule
* Handle resignations, run exit interviews, and coordinate full and final settlement
* Keep HRMS records, leave data, and personnel files accurate for both offices
* Coordinate statutory requirements such as provident fund and state insurance with the finance team

**On experience, read this carefully**

1. 5 to 8 years in HR
2. Of which at least 3 years must be spent directly managing a team, with people reporting to you and their performance your responsibility
3. Total years in the profession is not the measure. We will ask who reported to you, for how long, what you were accountable for, and what you did when one of them was not performing

**Must have**

* Hands-on recruitment ownership, not oversight of a process somebody else ran
* Campus recruitment you can evidence: institutes, programs, numbers
* Experience hiring for more than one kind of role. This job is technical hiring and operations hiring both
* Practical use of AI tools in your own work. Not awareness. Use
* Appraisal and lifecycle processes run end to end
* Experience managing people you do not sit with every day
* Working knowledge of an HRMS and of Indian statutory requirements
* Clear written and spoken English, and the confidence to hold a position with senior leadership

**Compensation**

Fixed compensation of 9 LPA to 14 LPA depending on experience

Based in Pune, work from office

Reports directly to the Chief Executive Officer inthe interim. As we build the department we will seek senior leadership at director and vice president level

title: HR Operations Partner(tickets, performance, labour laws, workforce transformation)
description:
**Basic Function**
The HR Operations Partner serves as a trusted operational and advisory partner to People Managers, HR Business Partners, HR Operations Specialists and Centers of Excellence, providing practical HR guidance and ensuring consistent and effective delivery of HR services.
  
  
The role combines broad HR generalist capability with a strong understanding of end-to-end employee lifecycle processes. It supports People Managers in navigating HR policies, processes, systems and employee matters, while coordinating across the HR organization to ensure issues are addressed through the appropriate channels.
  
  
As a senior individual contributor, the HR Operations Partner is expected to independently manage complex manager queries and escalations, exercise sound judgement, identify operational and compliance risks, and drive matters through to resolution. The role will also contribute to strengthening manager capability, improving HR processes and supporting the continued evolution of the HR operating model.
  
  
The role requires good knowledge of India employment and statutory requirements and an ability to translate regulatory and policy requirements into practical HR Operations execution.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
**People Manager Partnership & Advisory**

* Act as a trusted HR Operations partner to People Managers, providing practical guidance on HR policies, processes, systems and employee lifecycle matters.
* Own and manage HR cases raised by People Managers, including complex queries and escalations on HR Policies and Process (hire to retire), driving cases through to resolution and engaging HR Business Partners, Employee Relations, Legal or COEs where specialist support is required.
* Strengthen manager capability through proactive guidance, coaching and practical tools that enable managers to navigate HR processes more effectively.
* Guide performance management processes ensuring alignment with organizational goals.

**HR Generalist & HR Business Partner Support**

* Apply broad HR generalist knowledge when supporting managers and HR colleagues across a range of employee and organizational matters.
* Partner closely with HR Business Partners, COEs in the operational execution of key people priorities and annual HR programs, including promotion and year-end cycles, organizational changes, workforce movements/transformation, talent processes and manager communications.
* Work across HR Operations, HR Business Partners, Employee Relations, Payroll, Compensation & Benefits, Talent, Mobility, Legal and other Centers of Excellence to coordinate effective solutions.

**End-to-End Employee Lifecycle**

* Possess a strong working knowledge of end-to-end hire-to-retire processes and the interdependence between HR Operations, HR Business Partners, Centers of Excellence, Payroll and HR systems.
* Coordinate complex employee lifecycle activities that require inputs from multiple HR teams, ensuring clarity of ownership, timely execution and a consistent employee and manager experience.

description:

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced Talent, Learning & Performance Business Partner to translate business strategy and workforce priorities into integrated capability plans that enable organisational performance, future skills development and transformation outcomes. The role partners with senior business leaders and HR stakeholders to diagnose capability needs, shape talent and learning priorities, and ensure the successful adoption and evaluation of capability interventions across a global and matrix environment.
  
  
Location: India, Egypt or Hungary
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Use workforce, learning and people data responsibly, ensuring privacy, fairness, transparency and appropriate human oversight

* Experienced in talent, learning, leadership, performance and skills-related practices within complex organisations
* Skilled in capability consulting and organisational diagnosis, with the ability to identify root causes and define integrated solutions
* Experienced in strategic workforce planning and translating business priorities into workforce and capability plans
* Proficient in learning needs analysis, performance consulting and intervention evaluation
* Strong analytical and data storytelling capabilities, using evidence to influence decisions and demonstrate measurable outcomes
* Effective at building credibility and influencing senior stakeholders across global and matrix environments
* Knowledgeable in responsible AI, privacy, fairness and ethical use of people data
* Demonstrated strengths in strategic thinking, commercial awareness, facilitation, collaboration, change leadership and delivery excellence
* Experience working within transformation-focused and multinational organisations is highly desirable
* Relevant professional qualification or equivalent professional experience

**What's In It For You**

* Opportunity to influence workforce capability and organisational transformation at scale
* Exposure to senior business leaders and strategic decision-making processes
* Work across diverse international markets and functions within a global organisation

You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced strategic workforce planning and capability consulting
* Organisational diagnosis and evidence-based decision-making
* Stakeholder management and executive-level influencing
* Talent, learning, leadership and performance integration methodologies
* Data-led workforce insights and impact measurement

Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. Power without pause. Heating, cooling and oil-free air without end. We keep our customers’ worlds on. From world-class events that last a few weeks to mining operations and remote communities who rely on us for decades.

* Workforce Experience & Continuous Improvement: Identify recurring workforce challenges and implement proactive interventions to improve employee experience, engagement, productivity, and retention.
* Continuous Improvement Initiatives: Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on the needs of the manufacturing teams, including supporting wage benchmarking and market competitiveness assessments.

**You Are**

title: Manager Total Rewards
description:
**MAIN PURPOSE**

Support and execute Total Rewards programs and initiatives including compensation, benefits, and reward-related activities with a primary focus on India, China, Australia, Europe, South Africa and other key region markets within APAC and EMEA.

Analyze Total Rewards, workforce, and compensation data to identify trends, generate actionable insights, and support data-driven business decisions, including pay equity analysis, labor cost optimization, retention risk identification, workforce planning, and reward program effectiveness. Be able to translate complex data into clear recommendations and conclusions to support business decisions.

Partners with PBPs and business leaders for the attraction, retention and motivation of our talent, while ensuring the consistent implementation of Orbia and Netafim Total Rewards philosophy, policies, and practices and promoting alignment and standardization across business units.

**DIMENSIONS OF JOB**

This is an
**individual contributor role**
.

Active member of the Total Reward community for Orbia and Netafim. A key partner in facilitating reward planning and operational initiatives, involved in development, implementation, monitor, execution, evaluation and optimization of Netafim's Total Reward Strategy, as it relates to the frameworks, policies, standards and processes, within Orbia's strategy, to ensure our ability to attract, engage, mobilize and retain talents, while remain competitive and cost effective.

**SCOPE OF THE JOB**

The geographical scope is related to the APAC and EMEA regions, with high focus on India, China, Australia, South African and Western Europe, due to headcount and business focus. This role may include travel within the region for meetings and project activities (subject to travel policy and guidelines).

**COMPLEXITY OF THE JOB**

Netafim APAC & EMEA Total Reward Manager will be responsible for overseeing all compensation and benefits related aspects in order to support the evolving needs of the business and legislation within the regions of scope.

**Key Areas of Responsibilities (KARs)**

List of max. 10 bullet points (can be used also in Perf Mgt Review if this will be part of What assessment in the future)

1. **Lead the administration and execution of Total Rewards programs across APAC and EMEA**
   , with primary responsibility for India, China, Australia, Europe, South Africa, ensuring alignment with Netafim and Orbia reward principles.
2. **Manage the annual compensation cycle**
   across the regions, including merit reviews, salary planning, bonus calculation and payouts, compensation recommendations, system administration, data validation, and stakeholder communications.
3. **Administer regional compensation programs**
   , including job architecture, salary structures, benchmarking, short- and long-term incentive programs, and support the continuous enhancement of reward practices based on market insights.
4. **Provide compensation and benefits consulting and operational support**
   to HR, business leaders, and people managers, ensuring consistent and compliant application of reward policies and guidelines.
5. **Conduct market analysis and benchmarking activities**
   to support compensation decisions, salary structure reviews, pay positioning, retention initiatives, and competitive Total Rewards practices.
6. **Support workforce planning, salary budgeting, and employment cost analysis**
   , partnering with Finance and HR stakeholders on annual budget exercises, labor cost forecasting, and reward-related business cases.
7. **Ensure governance, compliance, and consistency**
   of Total Rewards programs by monitoring regional legislation, regulatory requirements, internal policies, and market practices.
8. **Manage relationships with regional vendors and external partners**
   , including benefits brokers, compensation survey providers, mobility providers, and payroll-related vendors.
9. **Support the One-Orbia Total Rewards agenda**
   by participating in regional and global initiatives, driving standardization, process improvements, and the adoption of common reward practices across business units.
10. **Act as project coordinator and regional representative**
    for corporate Total Rewards projects, including compensation harmonization, benefits optimization, job architecture, mobility, recognition, and rewards technology initiatives.

**EDUCATION REQUIRED**

* Minimum: Bachelor degree in Engineering OR Economics OR Humanities Subjects

* Desirable: Master level Or Post Graduation Qualification in HR ( MBA – HR) from Tier 1 / 2 college / University . Certificate course in Compensation & Benefits Mgt will be an added advantage.

**KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED**

* Strong understanding of all reward practices within the designated regions
* Trusted partner and advisor to the business and global peers
* Sound Project management skills
* Able to inspire people without having direct report and stimulate effective working processes
* Self-starter with hands-on mentality plus analytical skills
* Transparent and strong communicator
* Independent and autonomous working style
* Fluent in English and ability to work in a cross-cultural environment
* Able to translate global frameworks into a local and regional context
* “Can do” mentality and not afraid of also taking ownership in operational work and reporting

**EXPERIENCE REQUIRED**

Demonstrable experience of managing the full cycle of reward activities across both operational and non operational levels,

* Internationally experienced reward professional with the APAC & EMEA regions.
* At least 4 years of experience as Reward professional in a multinational company, operating in a matrix structure. Additional experience in payroll or as People business partner might be an added value.
* Ability to act strategically in a complex environment with high standard of personal integrity.
* Solid experience in dealing with multiple projects while also being hands on project member.
* Able to inspire people and stimulate effective working processes.

Fluent in English and ability to work in a cross-cultural environment

Amazon is looking for an enthusiastic candidate to join the fast paced world of Payroll Operations at India service center. We’re not an average retailer and this is definitely not your average Payroll Management position. We’ll give you the opportunity to really make a difference to our business by working on and initiating projects in a fast-paced environment and ultimately delivering results.
  
  
It is critical to Amazon’s on-going success that we provide the highest service to our employees. If you are motivated to dive into the detail and take ownership, we have the career you’re looking for!
  
  
**About Amazon**
Amazon strives to be earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. We treat every day like day one: a day to bring in fresh ideas, a day to challenge convention, a day to make more good things happen for our customers. It’s that kind of entrepreneurial spirit that will drive our success now, and reinforce our reputation for great service for years to come. You could be part of it. It’s as simple as this: Work hard. Have fun. Make history.
  
  
**About The Role**
Amazon is looking for a strong operational leader with excellent communication skills and a strong proven background in delivering multiple payrolls. The role is a fantastic opportunity for a leader, who wants to raise the bar for the payroll team and set the team up for success. The successful candidate will lead one of the sub-regional Payroll teams located in Hyderabad, Pune. She/He will be responsible to be the payroll operational leader for Multiple countries payroll management and leading team of 70+. This position will be responsible for all aspects of the team's operations including: hiring, training, and employee development; managing group workload and establishing priorities; ensuring existing policies and procedures are followed; managing annual performance targets and operating budget; creating and monitoring appropriate performance metrics. This position will also act as an escalation point in resolving complex outstanding issues with internal and external business partners. Overall responsible for Audit compliance and Business controls. The role requires a candidate with ability to manage and improve the payroll operations (performance metrics, internal controls, compliance, automation…) as well as to manage regional projects. The candidate will interact with senior and executive stakeholders worldwide.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Key Strategic Objectives
  
  

* Contributes to the strategic direction of the company based on internal and industry knowledge
* -Responsible for developing and communicating team or department vision and goals
* Build and monitor a consolidated Payroll Operations annual operating plan to forecast headcount needs with detailed analysis of budget to actual results on a monthly and quarterly basis
* Partner with external stakeholders HR, HRS, Accounting, Treasury (external to Payroll department)
* Partner with internal stakeholders Compliance, Controllership, Payroll Transformation, Payroll Academy
* Responsible to develop and implement systems to support rapid growth
* Performs autonomously and initiate and manages complex, departmental and/or cross- company work
* Build scalable processes to recruit, train and develop business professionals to support business expansion
* Lead performance review processes with VPs, Directors and senior leaders across functions in the region

People Management
  
  
Leading and developing a team, including: hiring, training and employee development; managing group workload and establishing priorities; ensuring existing policies and procedures are followed; managing annual performance, targets; creating and monitoring appropriate performance metrics; succession planning; resource planning. Coaching junior first time people managers. Responsible for 70+ team members including second line managers, first line managers and individual contributors.
  
  
Professional traits that are not unique to this position, but necessary for Amazon leaders
  
  

* Absolutely obsessed to provide a best of class customer experience to Amazon's employees and managers
* Build, inspire and motivate the teams to raise the bar
* Liaise with key stakeholders for procedural changes
* Maintain relationship with key internal and external partners
* A strong passion for hiring and developing people 6. Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines while managing multiple projects
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment
* Strong analytical skills to identify potential impact and implications of issues and takes appropriate action to avoid future recurrences
* Exhibits excellent judgment
* Leads with data and develops audit mechanisms to stay close to the data
* Has relentlessly high standards
* Thinks strategically, but stays on top of tactical execution
* Expects and requires innovation of her/his team
* Thinks big and has convictions
* Results oriented

**Basic Qualifications**

* 12+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
* 8+ years of applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses experience
* 8+ years of building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making experience
* 7+ years of hiring, leading and developing teams experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 8+ years of hiring, leading and developing teams experience
* 8+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
* 8+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
* 8+ years of mentoring junior finance and/or business team members experience
* 5+ years of working with senior staff (e.g. c-suite) experience
* MBA, or CPA

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Resource Manager Lead
description:
**Job Title: Resource Manager Lead**
**Hybrid Role (Two days per week in the Pune Office/3 days remote)**
**Work Shift: 6:30PM-3:30AM IST**
The RMO Resource Manager Lead provides strategic oversight of enterprise-wide resource allocation, supervises Resource Managers, and ensures efficient workforce planning aligned to organizational priorities. This role partners closely with PMO, Delivery, Sales, and Services leadership, drives continuous improvement in resource management processes, and escalates critical resourcing challenges to senior leadership.
  
  
**Key Duties & Responsibilities**

* Lead and supervise RMO Resource Managers, including performance management, hiring recommendations, and professional development.
* Oversee allocation of PMO Project Managers and Delivery resources to ensure balanced workloads across projects.
* Review and approve fulfillment of resource requests, ensuring prioritization based on strategic demand.
* Ensure team maintains accurate skills matrices, certifications, and availability data in Certinia (PSA).
* Collaborate with Sales, PMO, and Delivery leadership to forecast future resource demand and capacity.
* Resolve escalated conflicts related to staffing, skill gaps, or capacity limitations.
* Improve and enforce RMO standard operating procedures and governance.
* Drive adoption and consistent use of resource management tools and analytics dashboards.
* Provide insights and reporting to leadership on resource utilization, capacity trends, and risks.

**Supervisory Responsibility**
:
  
  
  

* This role directly supervises Resource Managers and may oversee additional resourcing personnel. Responsible for team workload distribution, operational oversight, and coaching to ensure performance excellence.

**Required Education And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, Operations, or a related field
* 5+ years of experience in supervision and resource management, workforce planning, or a similar role
* Proficiency in Certinia (PSA) or similar resource management technology
* Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills
* Knowledge of project management and related business processes
* Dependable, flexible, and adaptable to new ACA initiatives and changing client needs.
* Ability to perform in fast-paced, dynamic, cross-functional environments.
* Ability to drive outcomes, multi-task and prioritize effectively.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and project management tools
* Attention to detail and ability to work independently with minimal supervision

**Preferred Education And Experience**

* Prior financial services / Governance, Risk, and Compliance work experience is a plus.
* Familiarity with Salesforce, Conga CLM, and Salesforce CPQ
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective coordination across teams and external partners.
* Experience managing high-value and complex resources in a professional services and/or consulting environment.
* RCMP® certification from RMI

**Required Skills And Attributes**

* Clear and concise communication skills to engage with project managers, delivery teams, and leadership.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and competing priorities effectively.
* Proactive in identifying resource-related issues and developing creative solutions; adept in balancing team needs with project priorities.
* Strong analytical skills to forecast resourcing needs.
* Proficient in resource management tools and software, as well as other productivity applications.
* Develop strategic plans to align resource availability with project demands and business goals.
* Strong time-management skills to prioritize and complete responsibilities efficiently.

**What working at ACA offers:**
We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. Our Total Rewards package includes medical coverage fully funded by ACA for employees and their family as well as access to Maternity & Fertility and Wellness programs. ACA also provides Personal Accident Insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Employee Discount programs and Employee Resource Groups. You’ll be granted time off for designated ACA Paid Holidays, Privilege Leave, Casual/Sick Leave, and other leaves of absence to support your physical, financial and emotional well-being.
  
  
**What we commit to:**
ACA is firmly committed to a policy of nondiscrimination, which applies to recruiting, hiring, placement, promotions, training, discipline, terminations, layoffs, transfers, leaves of absence, compensation and all other terms and conditions of employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

title: HR IT Administrator
description:
**We Offer**

* The Dormakaba Administrator will be part of the IT Global HR service team. Dormakaba (EXOS and B-COMM HCM) is currently being used in various countries, but has been managed decentrally and only by external partners so far. Dormakaba was recently added to the IT Global HR service portfolio, aiming to centralize management of the system set up and associated business processes, build up internal knowledge, professionalize vendor relationships etc. This role will drive this process and the incorporation into our services application portfolio. The role will also act as the main point of contact for business and IT regarding Dormakaba and will provide key maintenance support going forward. (70%)
* This role will also act as the Specialist for one other dedicated HR IT system – the specific system is still to be defined. Training will be provided. (30%)

**Accountabilities**
**Tasks and Qualifications:**

* Act as Dormakaba Specialist (70%)
* Support establishing an international support framework for Dormakaba with clear roles and responsibilities on business, IT and external side – leveraging global and local stakeholders
* Document the setup of our different Dormakaba instances, identify areas of optimization and harmonization and work with stakeholders to realize these goals
* Lead the design and delivery of new Dormakaba solutions and changes to existing configurations
* Act as 1st and 2nd level support for end users
* Run, maintain and monitor the Dormakaba instances, and complete upgrades as appropriate
* Support integrations to global and local systems, like Workday and SAP
* Ensure that solutions are scalable, maintainable, and meet performance requirements
* Ensure all processes are completed in alignment with Global IT standards and governance.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, including solution design documents, functional specifications, test plans, and cutover activities according to IT Governance standards
* Act as Specialist for other HR IT system (30%)
* Exact system to be defined, e.g. Qualtrics or WalkMe
* Perform 1st level support activities and participate in system-related projects after training
* Understand functional requirements and implement these, while following internal IT Governance processes

**Required Core Competencies And Skill Sets**

* Strong problem solving and analytical skills
* Excellent communication and intercultural skills that allow smooth collaboration with the business, incl. coordination around system administration, following up on to dos, timelines etc.
* Business Analyst mindset to understand the internal customer’s requirements and find the best solution for them
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team
* Willingness to dive into and learn new systems
* Experience in working in an international environment

**Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or with several years of relevant professional experience
* Approx. 3 years experience in administration or implementation of Dormakaba

**Qualifications/Specialization**

* Dormakaba Administration experience
* English C1
* German: B1 or higher

title: Staff HR Technology Solutions Architect
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Staff HR Technology Architect is the senior technical authority for OpenGov’s HR technology ecosystem, responsible for the architecture, integration design, and long-term technical direction of the systems that manage employee data across the entire employee lifecycle. Based in Pune and reporting to the Director of Enterprise Applications and Engineering, this individual-contributor role sets the technical vision for the Workday platform and the broader HR application portfolio, ensuring the ecosystem is scalable, secure, compliant, and aligned to the needs of a global workforce across the US and India.
  
  
We are looking for a seasoned architect with deep domain and technical expertise across the Workday platform and the adjacent, integrated systems that make up the HR technology ecosystem — spanning payroll, benefits, talent management, talent acquisition, onboarding and offboarding, employee engagement, compliance, and HR operations. This is a hands-on, staff-level individual contributor with a dotted-line leadership mandate: no direct reports, but expected to guide and mentor HR application administrators, lead virtual teams on major initiatives, and influence the direction both technical and business teams take with HR technology. While the role is primarily architecture and design, it also carries hands-on technical delivery — the architect personally builds and delivers the most complex or high-risk integrations, configurations, and reports. The architect owns integration architecture and the HR data model end to end across best-of-breed systems, partners with the Manager, HR Technology on delivery, and serves as the design authority on data governance, security, and emerging AI and automation across the stack.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Technical Architecture & Systems Design**

* Own the end-to-end architecture of the HR technology ecosystem — Workday (Core HCM, Payroll, Benefits, Absence, Time Tracking, Compensation, Recruiting, Talent, Reporting, and Security) and the surrounding application portfolio — establishing design standards, patterns, and technical roadmaps.
* Own the architecture across a best-of-breed, multi-platform landscape — the core HRIS (Workday) plus payroll (e.g., ADP), applicant tracking (Ashby), employee engagement (CultureAmp), ERP (e.g., NetSuite), SSO/identity, compliance/training platforms, data-warehousing and BI tooling (e.g., Snowflake), and iPaaS/integration platforms (e.g., Workato) — ensuring the systems interoperate as a coherent whole.
* Define target-state architecture and multi-year technical roadmaps that scale with a growing, globally distributed workforce, balancing configuration, extensibility, and total cost of ownership.
* Evaluate new Workday releases, features, and third-party solutions; make build-vs-configure-vs-buy recommendations and lead architecture and design reviews.
* Provide deep, hands-on technical expertise across the ecosystem — anchored in the Workday stack (advanced configuration, the business process framework, calculated fields, security design, and complex reporting) and extending to adjacent platforms such as ADP, Ashby, CultureAmp, and NetSuite/ERP.

**Integration Architecture & Data Flows**

* Design and govern the integration architecture across the HR ecosystem (e.g., ADP, Ashby, engagement survey, SSO/identity, ERP, and downstream data-warehouse/BI platforms such as Snowflake), leveraging iPaaS/integration platforms (e.g., Workato) where appropriate and establishing patterns, standards, and error handling and monitoring.
* Own the HR data model and the flow of employee data from hire to retire, ensuring integrity, lineage, and consistency across integrated systems.
* Serve as design authority for Workday integrations (EIB, Core Connectors, Studio, and web service APIs), iPaaS platforms (e.g., Workato), and downstream data platform feeds.
* Maintain a working understanding of how HRIS data ties into ERP (e.g., NetSuite) and other enterprise systems, and lead the design of those interfaces.

**Technical Strategy & Influence**

* Set the technical direction for HR technology and influence the decisions both technical and business teams make when adopting or changing technology.
* Partner with HR Operations, Payroll, Benefits, Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, HR Business Partners, IT, and Workplace leaders to translate business strategy into a coherent systems strategy.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to leadership, framing trade-offs, risks, and options for major HR technology investments and platform decisions.
* Provide dotted-line technical leadership and mentorship to HR application administrators; lead virtual and matrixed teams on large initiatives and build technical depth and backup coverage across critical domains.

**Data Governance, Security & AI**

* Serve as the design authority for HR data governance, privacy, and security — defining data structures, access models, and controls across the US and India.
* Establish standards for HR data quality, master data, and reporting and analytics that feed data-warehouse and BI platforms (e.g., Snowflake).
* Identify and pilot opportunities to apply automation and AI within the HR technology stack, establishing responsible-use and data-handling guardrails.
* Ensure the architecture supports compliance requirements across geographies (audits, policy acknowledgements, and mandatory training) and evolving data-privacy regulations.

**Delivery, Vendors & Best Practices**

* Lead complex, cross-functional HR technology projects end to end from an architecture and design standpoint — shaping solutions, reviewing designs, and guiding delivery teams.
* Stay hands-on with technical delivery — personally building and delivering the most complex or high-risk configurations, integrations, and reports rather than limiting the role to design and oversight.
* Partner with the Manager, HR Technology and the administration team to translate architecture into configuration, and maintain documentation of architecture, standards, and system specifications.
* Manage strategic third-party vendor and implementation-partner relationships from a technical and architecture perspective.
* Stay current on Workday releases, HR technology trends, and best practices; exhibit sound judgment, discretion, and confidentiality in handling sensitive employee data.

**Requirements And Preferred Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.
* 10+ years of progressive HR technology / HRIS functional and technical experience, including significant time in an architecture, principal, or senior technical individual-contributor capacity.
* Demonstrated experience as a technical authority who sets direction and influences both technical and business stakeholders — this is a senior individual-contributor role, not an entry-level or first architecture role.
* Deep, hands-on expertise in a core HRIS — Workday strongly preferred — across the full module stack (Absence, Benefits, Compensation, Core HCM, Payroll, Recruiting, Reporting, Security, Talent, Time Tracking), including advanced configuration and the business process framework.
* Hands-on experience across a multi-platform HR technology ecosystem — not limited to a single HRIS — including payroll (e.g., ADP), applicant tracking (Ashby preferred), employee engagement (CultureAmp preferred), SSO/identity, and compliance/training platforms.
* Strong Workday integration expertise (EIB, Core Connectors, Studio, and web services/APIs) and proven experience designing enterprise integration architectures, including iPaaS/integration platforms (e.g., Workato).
* Expertise in HR data modeling, data governance, and how HRIS data flows into downstream data-warehouse and BI systems (e.g., Snowflake).
* Experience with data-warehousing tools (e.g., Snowflake) and iPaaS/integration platforms (e.g., Workato).
* Willingness and ability to perform hands-on technical delivery — configuration, integration development, and reporting — in addition to architecture, design, and oversight; this is not a design-only role.
* Broad domain expertise across payroll, benefits, talent management, talent acquisition, onboarding/offboarding, employee engagement, and general HR operations.
* Experience supporting HR systems across multiple geographies, ideally including both the US and India.
* Proficiency with Workday report writing and complex calculated fields.
* Experience with an applicant tracking system (Ashby preferred) and an employee engagement survey platform (CultureAmp preferred).
* Demonstrated ability to mentor administrators and provide dotted-line technical leadership without formal reporting authority.

**Payroll Analyst / Sr. Analyst**
**About Snowflake**
Our teams breed ambition, challenge ordinary thinking, push the pace of innovation, in-service of the exploding demand for accessible data.
  
  
Snowflake is growing fast and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We’re passionate about our people, our customers, our values and our culture! We’re also looking for people with a growth mindset and the pragmatic insight to solve for today while building for the future. And as a Snowflake employee, you will be accountable for supporting and enabling diversity and belonging.
  
  
**Summary**
Snowflake is looking for an experienced
**Payroll Analyst /Sr Analyst - EMEA**
. This position will be based in Pune, India. The position will support the
**EMEA region and hence working hours will be accordingly**
. You are versatile, motivated, creative, intellectually curious, analytical collaborator and a strong communicator.
  
  
Reporting into Payroll Lead / Manager, your main responsibility is to ensure smooth delivery of the day-to-day operations of the department. You will provide ideas and help brainstorm on process standardization, automation, and improvement in all aspects of payroll to ensure their scalability and continuing effectiveness amid all the changes that Snowflake has been undergoing. You are good at creating and maintaining robust process documentation. You adhere to the internal controls as specified by Company policies. You are expected to collaborate with cross functional business partners. This is the perfect opportunity for someone like yourself who is self-sufficient, possesses a keen attention to detail, and has an unwavering desire for continuous personal development.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Working closely with existing international payroll partners to ensure accurate and on-time payroll processing. Overall delivery of end-to-end payroll operations including:

+ Preparing and adhering to a schedule / payroll calendar and agree the timelines with payroll vendor and other internal stakeholders
+ Accurately capturing all inputs to be provided to the payroll vendors in a timely manner
+ Thorough review of the output. Includes but not limited to performing payroll analysis such as total gross payroll to net payment, average paid per headcount by country, and comparison of analysis to prior period
+ Support monthly/quarterly accounting close activities, account maintenance and reconciliations, financial reporting and variance analysis, etc.
+ Provide hands off to the accounting teams post payroll close to ensure accounting of payroll within the timelines prescribed by the close calendar
+ Ensure compliance with local jurisdictions for activities within the payroll domain including statutory filings and key annual audits
+ Monitor and measure the SLAs as agreed with the payroll vendor. Raise matter where there are slippages and recommend corrective action to management

* Working closely with other functional teams (e.g. HR, Stock Administration, People Operations, Benefits, Recruiting, Legal and accounting) to streamline cross-functional processes
* Recognizing opportunities and recommending process improvements also involves assisting with the design and implementation of internal control measures to ensure proper payment authorizations and segregation of duties.
* Providing excellent payroll support to employees and cross-functional teams by addressing inquiries, concerns, and requests.
* Providing standard and ad-hoc payroll reports as needed by various internal departments such as Finance, Accounting, Legal, Benefits, and People Operations.
* Creating and/or maintaining payroll documentation as it relates to processing, operational procedures, compliance, and other payroll-related matters.
* Providing support in various system implementation projects as needed.
* Provide support to external and internal audits for the area of payroll

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s / master’s degree in business, Finance, or Accounting
* 5 to 10 years of relevant and progressive payroll experience; public company payroll experience required
* Preferred hands-on experience working on some of these payrolls – Poland, Israel, Spain and other EMEA countries.
* Experience working with international payroll platforms such as ADP, EY, Cloudpay, or other global payroll platforms preferred.
* Experience of other international payrolls will be an added advantage.
* Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Highly proficient in utilizing various computer applications such as Microsoft Excel (Pivots, V/H Lookups) and Google Suite apps (e.g. Google Sheets)
* Familiarity with Workday HCM and Workday Financials is a plus
* Understanding of accounting, taxation, and finance concepts as it relates to payroll
* Possesses in-depth knowledge of payroll-related compliance requirements
* Adaptable to a fast-changing work environment; able to deliver accurate and on-time payroll regardless of the circumstances
* Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work in a team environment
* Ability to manage through change and to lead change when appropriate
* Attention to detail, organized and thorough with the desire for continuous improvement
* Proactive and problem-solving attitude
* Good command on English speaking and writing
* Adapts quickly to changes in a dynamic organizational structure and business processes
* Flexible with working hour changes.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.
  
  
How do you want to make your impact?

title: Regional Workday Specialist
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
As part of a wider HR transformation program and the spin-off of Siemens Energy from Siemens, Siemens Energy is in the process of standardizing and harmonizing its HR systems and services. We are seeking a knowledgeable and experienced Workday Consultant to join our team as a regional point of contact for all topics related to Workday. The ideal candidate will have expertise in configuring, deploying, and supporting our Workday solution across various modules such as HCM, Security, Compensation, Talent and Absence Management. This role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to deliver efficient, scalable Workday implementations and enhancements. This is an excellent opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment with a business in the forefront of the Energy Transition.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* As a regional Workday support specialist, you are the primary point of contact for all Workday related questions and issues for your supported region
* Analyse business requirements or change requests and translate them into Workday configurations and solutions for your specific region
* Acting as a liaison between the internal business partners and external vendors to support the Workday post-implementation and ongoing administration.
* Reviewing open cases/issues in the region with Application Management Service provider and ensure that all tickets are closed in a timely manner
* Provide functional and technical support to stakeholders and end-users including offering post-implementation support and ongoing maintenance of the Workday system.
* In addition to the regional responsibility, you may be assigned as a Global Functional Lead for one of Workday modules, such as HCM, Absence, Compensation, Reporting / Data and Security.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Information Technology, Business, or related field.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with Workday, including system configuration and support.
* Workday Reporting Experience and Expertise.
* Workday certification in one or more modules (preferred Reporting).
* Strong understanding of HR/Payroll/Business processes (depending on module focus).
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience with Workday integrations (a plus).

**About The Team**
In this role you will be working within the Human Resources function – HR Systems and Services, a truly global and diverse team of specialists with an open mindset, responsible for guaranteeing operational performance and budget adherence of HR Systems & Services, ensuring, and maintaining fit-for-purpose HR systems and processes, safeguarding end-to-end delivery while promoting Siemens Energy digital transformation. You will get all the trust and empowerment to be successful.
  
  
**Who is Siemens Energy?**
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. We meet the growing energy demand across 90+ countries while ensuring our climate is protected. With more than 92,000 dedicated employees, we not only generate electricity for over 16% of the global community, but we’re also using our technology to help protect people and the environment.
  
  
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
  
  
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and compassion. Our combined creative energy is fuelled by at least 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society. All of society.

* All employees are automatically covered under the Medical Insurance. Company paid considerable Family floater cover covering employee, spouse and 2 dependent children up to 25 years of age.
* Siemens Energy provides an option to opt for Meal Card to all its employees which will be as per the terms and conditions prescribed in the company policy.As a part of CTC, tax saving measure
* Flexi Pay empowers employees with the choice to customize the amount in some of the salary components within a defined range thereby optimizing the tax benefits. title: Learning & Development Specialist
description:

* Design and develop unique learning solutions and programs that foster social learning and learning-by-doing, leveraging both in-house and sourced content

title: HR Service Agent
description:
Job Title
  
  
HR Service Agent
  
  
**Job Description**
**HR Service Agent | Pune, India | Full-time**
If you are passionate about delivering an excellent employee experience, resolving HR queries, and continuously improving HR service delivery in a global organization, this could be the ideal opportunity for you.
  
  
**Your Role**
As an HR Service Agent, you will be part of Vanderlande’s Global HR Service Desk within the Regional HR & Services organization, based in Pune, India. You will report to the Regional HR Service Desk Lead APAC. Vanderlande’s Global HR organization comprises four main areas Business HR, Reward & Mobility, Talent Acquisition & Learning, and Regional HR & Services. The Regional HR & Services team provides local HR expertise while also supporting global HR service delivery through the Global HR Service Desk and Global HR Specialists team. As part of a team of nine HR Service Agents, you will serve as the first point of contact for employees based in the Netherlands. You will resolve first-line HR queries relating to policies, processes, and systems, execute basic HR transactions, and guide employees and managers in using employee and manager self-service tools. You will play a key role in delivering an efficient, consistent, and positive employee experience, with a strong focus on operational excellence and continuous improvement.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
HR Service Delivery & Operational Excellence
  
  

* Deliver a seamless and consistent employee experience while maintaining service efficiency and quality.
* Resolve first-line employee queries related to HR policies, processes, and systems, escalating complex cases to the relevant specialists when required.
* Record and document employee inquiries using the ticketing and case management system.
* Meet defined Service Level Agreement (SLA) targets by providing accurate, consistent, and timely support.
* Execute back-office HR processes and transactions in accordance with established policies and standard operating procedures.
* Conduct the necessary research to investigate queries and support effective resolution.
* Guide employees and managers through self-service transactions, HR portal navigation, and HR policy interpretation to encourage independent resolution.
* Use data and service insights to monitor performance, identify trends, and improve the employee experience.
* Support ad hoc projects and activities within the Regional HR & Services organization.

Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Collaborate with Regional HR & Services stakeholders to understand, implement, and improve HR processes, with a focus on employee experience and employee life events.
* Identify recurring service issues and proactively recommend improvements.
* Lead or support the implementation of process and service delivery enhancements.
* Drive local improvements in collaboration with HR stakeholders and other relevant teams.

**What You Bring**

* At least 3 years of experience in first-line HR support.
* A good understanding of local HR policies and procedures is desirable.
* A data-driven approach with the ability to use information and insights to support effective service delivery.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Intermediate knowledge of Microsoft 365 tools, particularly Outlook, Excel, and Word.
* Experience with Workday or another HR information system is an advantage.
* Proficiency in English is essential.

**About Vanderlande**
Vanderlande makes automated systems that handle baggage at airports and sort parcels in logistics networks around the world. At airports, our technology manages the complete bag journey—from check-in and security screening through to the reclaim belt. In parcel logistics, our systems power the networks that get packages to customers’ doors. At Vanderlande, you will find the space to aspire, to grow, and to achieve something that matters, with people who bring out the best in each other.

www.vanderlande.com

+ 22 paid leave days.

* Flexible and hybrid working model that promotes work-life balance.

* Comprehensive medical insurance coverage, including parental coverage.
* Opportunities to participate in diverse Vanderlande communities, networks, and employee initiatives.
* The opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders across the globe.

**How We Work**
We work by three values Every day better, We care, and Team play. In practice, this means we drive customer success, lead with transparency, celebrate what we achieve together, and do what we say.
  
  
**Ready to Apply?**
Are you interested in this position? Apply directly via our careers page with your CV/Resume.

At Vanderlande, we believe that innovation and success come from bringing together people with different perspectives, experiences, and ways of thinking. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued and empowered to contribute, develop and grow. description:

The quality of school education available to students from low-income communities across India is abysmal. Their chances of attending college or building a career are significantly lower than their high-income peers, condemning them to a life without voice or choice. iTeach was born in 2015 to challenge this status quo and create a level playing field for ALL children.

We run free and high-impact schools and an exceptional college-to-career program for the most disadvantaged students in Pune and Navi Mumbai. We are known for our world-class professional development, our result-oriented team culture, and our student-centric school design. Read more about us at
www.iTeachSchools.org
.

**Role Overview :**

The HR Payroll Associate will work closely with the HR Manager and coordinate closely with Finance to own end-to-end payroll processing, HRMS administration, and employee lifecycle documentation for iTeach Schools across Pune and Mumbai. This role is critical in ensuring that every employee is paid accurately and on time, that statutory compliance is never at risk, and that payroll data stays audit ready as the organization scales.

**Key Responsibilities:**

This role is for someone who enjoys working with numbers, solving payroll-related challenges, and ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time. As an HR Payroll Associate, you will manage key aspects of the employee lifecycle from onboarding and maintaining employee records to monthly payroll, salary revisions, exits, and full-and-final settlements. You will work closely with HR and Finance teams to ensure payroll accuracy, statutory compliance, strong controls, and smooth employee experience.

**1. Monthly Payroll & Data:**

* Collect and validate monthly payroll inputs such as attendance, leaves, reimbursements, deductions etc Audit attendance and leave data before payroll processing.
* Share all relevant data with the finance team to process payroll for employees, consultants and interns.
* Maintain any and all kinds of HR data pertaining to employees.

**2. Onboarding, Exit and Full-and-Final Settlement:**

* Complete joining formalities and verify PAN, bank details, address, ID and employment documents; set up accurate employee records in the HRMS/payroll system before the first salary cycle.
* Maintain confidential, audit-ready personnel and payroll records.
* Coordinate resignation documentation, notice-period records, asset clearance and no-dues confirmation.
* Prepare and validate full-and-final settlements (unpaid salary, bonus).

**3. Salary Revisions & Increments:**

* Implement approved increments, promotions, transfers and salary-structure changes in the HRMS.
* Verify effective dates, revised CTC, fixed/variable components, deductions and statutory impact.

**4. Compliance & Employee Support:**

* Support PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, LWF, TDS, gratuity and bonus processes.
* Maintain compliance calendars, challans, returns and payroll audit documentation.
* Resolve employee queries on salary, leave, tax and settlements.

**Prerequisites:**

* Graduate in HR, Commerce, Accounting or related fields.
* Min 2 years hands-on payroll and HR operations experience, having independently run at least 12 monthly payroll cycles.
* Working knowledge of PF, ESI, PT, LWF, TDS, gratuity and bonus; experience with an HRMS/payroll platform. (e.g. Keka, SAP)
* Strong Excel skills.
* Clear communicator, comfortable managing stakeholders across HR, Finance and school teams.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

We take pride in offering competitive compensation and benefits commensurate with the candidate's education and work experience. The salary range for this position is ₹4.32 - 5.28 LPA CTC, and we are dedicated to providing a top-notch industry benefit. These benefits include PF, gratuity, medical insurance (up to 3 lakh PA), paid leaves, annual increments, and promotion opportunities.

**Location:**
Pune.
