title: People Operations Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
We are seeking a People Operations Specialist to join our People Operations team in Pune. This role will support core People Operations processes across the employee lifecycle and serve as a reliable partner to employees, managers, and cross-functional stakeholders across India and APAC.
  
  
The role requires strong operational skills, attention to detail, a customer-focused approach, and the ability to manage employee transactions accurately and independently within defined processes. The role will also have opportunities to support process improvements, benefits administration, and regional People Operations initiatives.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Manage day-to-day People Operations processes including onboarding, employee transfers, job and data changes, leave administration, compensation changes, benefits, and terminations across supported locations.
* Process employee transactions accurately and ensure required approvals, documentation, and system updates are completed within defined timelines.
* Use Workday, Greenhouse, Jira, and other People systems to maintain accurate and timely employee data.
* Serve as a point of contact for routine People Operations queries, supporting employees and managers through email, Slack, Jira, and other channels.
* Partner with People Operations, Payroll, People Business Partners, Finance, IT, Workplace, Talent Acquisition, and other teams to support smooth execution of People processes.
* Support the implementation and localization of People processes across India and APAC.
* Maintain accurate employee records and support regular data audits and compliance checks.
* Develop a working understanding of applicable employment legislation and statutory requirements, particularly in India, and escalate potential compliance concerns appropriately.
* Support People Operations projects, including process improvements, system enhancements, testing, automation, and documentation.
* Identify opportunities to simplify and improve day-to-day processes and contribute ideas to enhance operational efficiency and employee experience.
* Support the administration of employee benefits across India and APAC, including enrollment, employee queries, vendor coordination, reconciliations, audits, and renewal activities.
* Handle sensitive and confidential employee information with appropriate discretion.

**Who You Are**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* 3–6 years of experience in HR/People Operations, preferably in a multinational or technology organization.
* Hands-on experience with employee lifecycle processes and Workday HCM; exposure to UAT/testing is preferred.
* Good understanding of India employment practices and HR operations; exposure to APAC processes is an advantage.
* Experience handling employee transactions and resolving routine operational issues with appropriate guidance and escalation.
* Exposure to process improvement, HR systems, automation, or operational excellence initiatives.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes clearly.
* Customer-focused and comfortable working with employees, managers, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to take ownership of assigned processes, work independently within defined guidelines, and escalate matters appropriately.
* Willingness and ability to learn new processes, systems, and regional requirements in a fast-paced, global environment.

***Important Note: This role requires working from our Pune office 3 days a week (hybrid work model)***
**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

description:

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking a business transformation and HR portfolio professional to connect enterprise transformation priorities with practical people-change delivery and disciplined portfolio governance.
  
  
Based in India or Egypt, the role will divide its focus equally between business transformation and people change, and HR portfolio and leadership enablement. You will help turn the Horizon 2 strategy into a clear narrative, targeted colleague journeys, practical capability-building activities and sustainable changes in everyday decisions and ways of working.
  
  
Working across transformation teams, HR Business Partners, Centres of Expertise, HR Services and senior leadership forums, you will maintain an integrated view of priorities, risks, dependencies, decisions and outcomes. The role has no direct or dotted-line reports and requires effective influence across a global, matrixed organisation
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

You have significant experience in business transformation, people change, portfolio management or strategy execution within a global, matrixed organisation.You have designed and delivered people-change plans supporting large-scale business transformation.You bring practical programme and portfolio management capabilities, including planning, governance, risk management, reporting, dependency management and delivery tracking.You can coordinate multiple programmes, workstreams and stakeholders to deliver measurable business and people outcomes.You communicate complex strategies through clear narratives, presentations, leadership materials and audience-specific messages.You can engage and influence senior stakeholders across HR, transformation, operational and business teams without relying on formal authority.You understand how people change supports customer outcomes, commercial performance and value creation.You use KPIs, surveys, colleague insights and business measures to evaluate adoption and impact.You create simple, repeatable and scalable working practices while maintaining sound judgement and attention to detail.You are confident using digital tools, AI and automation, and can adapt effectively in an evolving environment.You hold a relevant degree or have equivalent professional experience. A recognised change, programme or project-management qualification would be advantageous.

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**
The opportunity to work at the intersection of enterprise transformation, people change and HR portfolio governance.Exposure to senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders across HR, transformation, technology, commercial and operational teams.The opportunity to influence how Horizon 2 is understood, adopted and sustained across VOIS.Experience shaping enterprise-wide campaigns, leadership communications and colleague journeys.The ability to establish governance, portfolio standards and repeatable practices that improve decision-making and delivery across a complex international organisation.Opportunities to use colleague insights, surveys, KPIs and the VOIS Scorecard to demonstrate measurable transformation outcomes
  
  
**What Skills You Will Learn**
Enterprise people-change planning across multiple transformation workstreams.Persona-led change-journey design and behaviour-change activation.Executive storytelling and the preparation of decision-ready leadership materials.HR portfolio governance, integrated planning and operating-rhythm design.Change adoption measurement using surveys, KPIs, colleague insights and scorecards.Cross-functional stakeholder influence within a global, matrixed organisation.Practical application of AI, automation and digital tools to improve portfolio efficiency.Translation of strategic transformation priorities into sustainable workplace behaviours and business-as-usual people processes
  
  
**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.

title: Chief People Officer
description:
**Chief People Officer — Open Links Foundation (Vinoba Program)**

Location: Wanawadi, Pune (Headquarter) | Full time | 1 position | Immediate joining | Reports to the CEO | Remuneration commensurate with experience

**About the organisation**

Open Links Foundation (OLF) is a technology-driven NGO working to improve the quality of education in government schools at scale, in partnership with the government and through the use of technology and behavioural science. Its Vinoba Program strengthens the efficiency of government education initiatives and supports and motivates teachers.

In the last four years, Vinoba has grown from a few hundred schools to 74,000+ schools, reaching over 54 lakh students across 42 districts in Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh and Bihar, with a team of about 150 people.

**The opportunity**

OLF is entering its next phase of growth and scale. Building a strong, capable and values-driven organisation is central to its ability to deliver its mission. The Chief People Officer will build the talent, leadership, culture and organisational capabilities required to support that growth, and will lead OLF’s talent, leadership development, performance, culture and people systems so that the organisation has the capability, culture and organisational effectiveness needed to achieve its mission at scale.

**What you will own**

1. **Talent Acquisition & Retention**
   — Ensure OLF has the right talent in the right roles at the pace its growth demands, while strengthening retention and building a strong talent pipeline.
2. **Leadership & Employee Development**
   — Build a capable and future-ready organisation by strengthening managerial and professional capabilities, developing a leadership pipeline, and ensuring succession for key roles.
3. **Performance & Organisational Effectiveness**
   — Create a high-performance, accountable organisation where people have clear goals, receive regular feedback, and are aligned with organisational priorities and outcomes.
4. **Employee Engagement & Culture**
   — Build an engaged, inclusive and values-driven organisation where people feel connected to OLF’s mission, take ownership, and are motivated to perform, contribute and grow.
5. **HR Systems, Operations & Compliance**
   — Build efficient and compliant people systems and processes that support growth while ensuring a consistent and positive employee experience.

**What we are looking for**

* Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration (HR), or a related field
* 12–15 years of relevant HR experience, including at least 5 years in a senior HR leadership role
* Proven experience building and implementing HR systems and processes across talent acquisition, employee development, performance management and organisational culture
* Experience scaling organisations, managing diverse teams and driving organisational effectiveness
* Strong understanding of employment laws, HR policies and people analytics
* Experience in the social sector or a mission-driven organisation is desirable
* Strong written and verbal communication in English and Hindi

**To apply**

Email your resume along with a note on why this position excites you to sanjay@openlinksfoundation.org & Priyanshi@openlinksfoundation.org

description:

title: Training and Placement Officer (Food Technology / Industry)
description:
**Position:**
Training and Placement Officer (TPO) - Food Technology

**Organization:**
MIT School of Food Technology

**Required Education:**
Bachelors in Food Technology & MBA

**Required Experience:**
6 to 8 years of experience in academic placements (Food Technology / Food Industry)

**Job Type:**
Full-time

**Location:**
MIT-ADT University, Rajbaug Educational Complex, Loni Kalbhor, Pune

**Department:**
Corporate Relations, Training & Placement Cell

**Job Purpose**

The Training and Placement Officer (TPO) will serve as the strategic bridge between the institute, students, and the food industry. The candidate will lead corporate relations, campus recruitment drives, industry-institute partnerships, and pre-placement readiness training tailored to students pursuing B.Tech, M.Tech, and Ph.D. degrees in Food Technology.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Campus Recruitment & Placement Management**

* Plan, execute, and oversee end-to-end placement drives (On-Campus, Off-Campus, and Pooled campus recruitment).
* Actively prospect, engage, and onboard leading national and multinational companies across the FMCG, Food Processing, Dairy, Beverage, Quality Assurance, and Agritech sectors.
* Achieve baseline and stretch targets for student placement percentage, median package, and top-tier company participation.
* Coordinate summer internships, winter projects, and industrial visits for undergraduate and postgraduate students.

**2. Corporate Relations & Industry Networking**

* Establish, maintain, and expand strategic partnerships with industry HR leaders, R&D heads, and plant managers in the food sector.
* Negotiate and finalize MoUs (Memorandums of Understanding) for industrial training, joint research projects, guest lectures, and student internships.
* Participate in trade fairs, food tech expos, industry roundtables, and corporate meets to build the MIT School of Food Technology brand.

**3. Student Skill Development & Career Guidance**

* Identify skill gaps in current cohorts in alignment with evolving food industry standards (e.g., FSSAI compliance, ISO/HACCP certifications, automation, product development).
* Organize specialized soft-skills training, resume-building workshops, technical mock interviews, group discussions, and aptitude prep modules.
* Provide personalized career counseling to align student career paths (R&D, QA/QC, Production Management, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs).

**4. Operations & Alumni Engagement**

* Maintain up-to-date databases of student profiles, company contacts, recruitment records, salary packages, and alumni networks.
* Leverage the Alumni network to generate job leads, mentorship opportunities, and industry referrals.
* Prepare placement reports, brochures, statistics, and presentation decks for institutional leadership and accreditation bodies (e.g., NAAC, NBA).

**Required Qualifications & Eligibility**

**Education (Mandatory)**

**Undergraduate:**
B.Tech / B.E. in Food Technology (or Food Process Engineering / Food Science & Technology).

**Postgraduate:**
MBA / PGDM (Specialization in Marketing, HR, General Management, or Agribusiness Management).

**Experience**

**Minimum Experience:**
6 to 8 years of experience in academic placements (Food Technology / Food Industry)

**Preferred Experience:**
Direct hands-on experience handling placements for Food Technology, or related allied domain students will be strongly preferred.

**Key Competencies & Technical Skills**

**Industry Knowledge:**
In-depth understanding of the Indian and global food processing ecosystem (FMCG, Agritech, Dairy, Cold Chain, Packaging, Quality Control).

**Corporate Network:**
An established network of HR contacts and talent acquisition managers in food and FMCG firms.

**Communication Skills**
: Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and negotiation skills.

**Leadership & Event Management:**
Proven ability to organize large-scale recruitment drives, seminars, and corporate guest sessions.

**Data & Tools:**
Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, CRM systems, and LinkedIn Talent Insights for corporate outreach.

**How to Apply:**

Interested candidates with the required educational qualifications
**(B.Tech in Food Technology + MBA)**
can send their updated resume along with a cover letter outlining their relevant placement track record to
**hr.resume@mituniversity.edu.in**
with the subject line "Application for TPO – MIT SOFT".

title: Workday Compensation & Benefits Lead
description:
Agilysis is looking for a seasoned Workday Compensation & Benefits Lead to for solution design and delivery across Compensation and Benefits engagements. This is a senior role for someone who can operate independently across the full delivery lifecycle, guide clients through complex configuration decisions, and bring structure and quality to the teams they work with.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Own the functional solution across Workday Compensation and Benefits engagements, taking accountability for design decisions from discovery through go-live.
* Lead client workshops and requirements sessions, helping HR, Finance, and Total Rewards stakeholders work through compensation structures, benefit plan design, eligibility rules, and enrollment frameworks.
* Translate nuanced and often complex client requirements into well-structured Workday solutions, clearly communicating design choices, risks, and alternatives to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for functional issues on Compensation and Benefits engagements, driving resolution across client, delivery, and technical teams.
* Build long-term relationships with client stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor on both immediate delivery needs and broader Workday strategy.
* Define the solution architecture across Workday Compensation and Benefits, ensuring design consistency, scalability, and adherence to Workday best practices.
* Lead configuration across Compensation and Benefits modules.
* Design and govern Business Process Frameworks (BPF) across both domains, ensuring routing, approval logic, and security policies are properly structured and maintainable.
* Lead or provide senior oversight on end-to-end Compensation and Benefits implementations, setting delivery standards and ensuring quality across configuration, testing, and documentation.
* Oversee hyper care support following go-live, ensuring benefit enrollments, compensation plans, and associated payroll deductions are functioning accurately in production.
* Proactively surface optimization opportunities within client environments, including configuration improvements, process simplification, and underutilized feature adoption.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 8+ years of Workday functional experience, with at least 4 years of focused, hands-on expertise across Workday Compensation and Benefits.

* Deep understanding of Workday Benefits, Compensation and Advanced Compensation architecture, business process design, and security framework as it relates to Compensation and Benefits.
* Proven experience leading client workshops, design reviews, and stakeholder conversations at both HR operational and leadership levels.
* Experience mentoring team members on configuration practices, testing standards, and delivery documentation.
* Proficiency in EIB-based data loading, custom reporting, and calculated fields within the Compensation and Benefits domain.
* Understanding of the Benefits-Payroll integration, including deduction codes, benefit plan mappings, and period-end reconciliation.

description:
**About Agoda**

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

**About Agoda**

 

 

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodation, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting edge technology that connects travelers with more than 2.5 million accommodations globally. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 4,000+ talents coming from 90+ different nationalities foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration. We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership, enabling our customers to experience the world.  

 

**Get to Know our Team:**

 

 

The Customer Experience Group of Agoda effectively serves our customers and partners to ensure satisfying results. This great task is accomplished with the support of our Global Service Vertical team. We serve as the backbone for Customer Experience Group’s global operations. Our team is comprised of project managers, process owners, analysts, and talent management. Together we work nonstop to improve the quality and efficiency of our customer and partner support processes. Working with the Global Service Vertical team is a great opportunity to collaborate with various stakeholders and develop initiatives with our sister companies and external partners all over the world. We are a very data-driven environment, eager to move fast and learn through experimentation. A clear focus on supporting our customers and partners is bolstered by a strong, entrepreneurial culture that enriches us and Agoda’s business performance.

 

 

 

**The Opportunity:**

 

The Senior Associate WFM Manager is a people leader in role, responsible for leading a WFM team, enabling them to be successful and delivering against the prescribed KPIs.

 

The Manager enables their team and team members by providing coaching and feedback, building strong professional relationships, maintaining a regular flow of communication, and providing direction, support, and development.

 

The Manager also contributes to the overall WFM performance and culture, collaborating with peers and broader colleagues to ensure WFM delivers to the company and CEG objectives.

 

The Senior Associate WFM Manager is expected to be an SME in Workforce Management, having a good knowledge of WFM concepts, to support the team with challenges and capability and to adequately represent WFM, to senior stakeholders.

 

 

 

**ACTIVITIES PERFORMED ON THE JOB:**

 

* ****Coaching and giving feedback:****

* Coaching and providing feedback within WFM (usually one-on-one) constructively and creatively, to enable colleagues to perform at their best.

* Review performance of individuals and team using performance reports/dashboards, observations, buddying, and reviewing system audit reports.

* Manage all underperformance, using the Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) process where appropriate.

* ****People leadership:****

* Build healthy and professional relationships with team members.

* Establish and nurture a culture of performance excellence, open feedback, collaboration, recognition, and quality delivery of outcomes.

* Organize team building activities that will engage people in teamwork and create a positive work environment.

* Ensure the team is well supported to perform their day-to-day activities, including:

* ensuring appropriate real-time support is available, taking and managing escalated issues.

* Providing approvals as part of the business process (e.g. absorption).

* Ensure team schedule is maintained to a high standard to provide stakeholder support and manage team requests and unplanned absence, in line with process.

* Provide clarity on performance vs targets, and any other team or group objectives.

* Use reward and recognition as part of motivating the team.

* Conduct team meetings: sharing important information, updates, performance progress, and broader company updates.

* Ensure your team is connected to the company's WFM objectives and strategy.

* Be an example to the team through behavior, living up to the Agoda values and behavior standards expected of people leaders.

* Collaborate with other departments, working together to enable overall success (e.g. WFM teams, CEG Operations Teams, CEG Teach Team).

* ****Reporting & data analysis:****

* Work with data from various sources to analyze and observe performance of CEG SLAs and gain insights as a basis for feedback and change suggestions.

* Prepare and present team performance data, challenges, issues, ideas, and opportunities.

* ****Collaboration:****

* Collaborate with local WFM team:

* On team performance: providing updates about the team, traffic, projects, concerns, challenges, and opportunities.

* Participate actively in leadership meetings: share what works well for you, provide feedback and input on decisions or updates, and be open and constructive about what is not working well and how the group can improve.

* Stay up to date with products, news, goals, decisions, projects.

* Collaborate with other teams:

* CEG Operations Leadership and Management.

* CEG GSV.

* ****Personal Management:****

* Remain up to date with important company/team/department updates, requirements.

* Act in the best interests of the organization: ensuring that we operate with absolute integrity and compliance with all legal obligations or compliance requirements.

* Be an active and constructive Agoda team member: Always being respectful to others and seeking to be better together.

* Aim to understand, then meet and exceed the expectations agreed with your manager.

 

**EXPECTATIONS - BEHAVIORS AND VALUES**

 

**Behavior**

 

**Definition**

 

***Continuous improvement***

 

Regularly identify improvement opportunities, quantify them, and follow through to measurable/demonstratable outcomes. Embraces both successes and failures to learn and maximize the benefits.
 
  

Embraces and drives change, is open and supportive of improvement opportunities identified by others.

 

***Deliver better together***

 

Collaborates and engages with colleagues and broader Agoda teams to share ideas and learn and work together toward shared ambitions.
 
  

Is respectful to colleagues, open to different perspectives /viewpoints, and positively contributes to discussions.

 

***Enable others` success***

 

Is committed to building and nurturing a culture of frequent feedback, coaching and career development. 
 
  

Provides clarity on accountability, goals, and progress.
 
  

Regularly takes the opportunity to connect and align teams and team members to the Agoda/CEG strategy, making these relevant and digestible.

 

 

**COMPETENCIES REQUIRED**

 

**Analytical Ability & Problem Solving**

 

Can visualise, articulate, conceptualise, or solve both complex and uncomplicated problems using the data available.

 

**Decision making ability**

 

Set a course of action purposely chosen from different alternatives to achieve company objectives.

 

**Effective communication**

(Verbal and written)

 

Delivers, receives, and interprets ideas and information, presents information appropriately to a diverse range of audiences, and influences partner decisions Excel/Power Point Skills

 

**Flexibility and Agility**

 

Can adjust behavior to new information and changing circumstances. Be open to new ways of doing things and always experiment with new methods. Works effectively in a dynamic environment.

 

**KPI management**

 

Create and execute a KPI plan designed to help achieve and evaluate success in reaching the company's goals.

 

**Listening and influencing**

 

Practice attentive and active listening. Can influence strategies that persuade key stakeholders to take action that will promote shared interests and business goals.

 

**Process Improvement**

 

Organise, evaluate, plan, and implement improvements in our internal and external processes and practices. Actively work on creating better processes once changes take place.

 

**Reporting**

 

 Be able to confidently give a written account of business metrics, projects, and team performance based on data, observations, or investigations.

 

**Result driven**

 

Driving high standards to accomplish challenging goals. Works hard to achieve them.

 

**Time / workload management & prioritization**

 

Creating a work environment where tasks and responsibilities are accomplished successfully within the time available.

 

**Coaching**

 

Support and develop team members to achieve a specific personal and professional goal by guiding and training.

 

**Develop and Manage team**

 

Govern and coordinate the team to perform in their job. Learn the skills, potential, and ambitions of the team members and define long term success.

 

**Operational Planning & Coordination**

 

Create and execute a detailed plan with the aim to provide a clear vision on how the team, department will contribute to the achievement of the company’s strategic goals

 

**People training**

 

Identify training needs, create, and develop training to help team members with specific knowledge or skills to improve performance in their current roles.

 

**Presentation**

 

Clearly conveys information and ideas through a variety of media to individuals or groups in a manner that engages the audience and helps them understand and retain the message.

 

**Team level KPI management**

 

Create and execute a team KPI plan designed to help achieve and evaluate success in reaching the company goals.

 

 

 

**Qualifications, Experience and Trainings required:**

 

**Qualifications**

 

High level written & verbal language/communication skills. Intermediate or above computer literacy (MS Excel particularly), high level problem solving / analytical reasoning skills. High level stakeholder management skills.

 

**Experience**

 

6+ years of

WFM experience

Experience in coaching and developing, in a technical environment.

 

Experience in delivering high-level business objectives or initiatives.

 

**Trainings**

 

OJT, WFM onboarding, RT Onboarding

 

 

**Must have:**

 

* Deep hands-on experience designing and configuring omnichannel routing strategies (email, voice, chat/messaging) using platforms such as Amazon Connect, Genesys Cloud/PureCloud, or equivalent CCaaS/ACD systems.

* Proven ability to build routing logic from the ground up — including skills-based routing, IVR/call flows, queues, priorities, and escalation paths — based on complex, nuanced business requirements.

* Strong understanding of contact center architecture (queues, agent skill profiles, SLAs, overflow/failover logic) and how to translate ambiguous business needs into scalable, technical routing designs.

* Experience integrating routing platforms with CRM/WFM/reporting tools (e.g., Salesforce, Verint, NICE) is a plus.

* Comfortable working directly with engineering/IT teams to implement and troubleshoot routing configurations, and able to independently own technical documentation of routing setups.

  

We welcome both local and international applications for this role. Full visa sponsorship and relocation assistance available.

title: Head Accounts & Administration
description:
**Job Title:**
Head – Accounts, Administration & Office Operations

**Location:**
Wakad, Pune (Work from Office)

**Experience:**
10+ years

**About Machine Maker**

Machine Maker is India’s B2B media and events platform for the manufacturing sector: The Voice of Manufacturing. Our roots go back to 2004, when we started with Industrial Business Mart. Today Machine Maker reaches manufacturers through print, digital, video, exhibitions, brand partnerships and Manufacturing Maestros, our community gatherings across Indian cities. We are a team of 20+ professionals in Pune, growing fast and building for the next level.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a mature, stable and highly capable professional to be the custodian of our office. This person will lead three areas: our complete accounts function, office administration, and people management. You will be the steady hand that keeps the organisation running well. You will hold processes, money, compliance and people to a high standard, so the leadership team can focus on growth.

This is not a routine accounts position. We want someone with authority and judgement: a strong administrator who can take charge, set discipline and earn the respect of the team.

**How This Role Fits In**

You will report directly to the Founder & Managing Editor and work closely with the leadership team. You will be the central point of control for finance, administration and office operations. Our editorial, video, sales and delivery teams will depend on you for a well-run workplace and reliable systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Office Custodianship*

* Own the smooth day-to-day running of the Wakad office: facilities, vendors, assets, security and office discipline
* Set and enforce office policies, processes and standards of conduct

*Accounts & Finance*

* Take complete charge of the accounts department: bookkeeping, invoicing, receivables, payables and reconciliations
* Manage salary processing, statutory compliance (GST, TDS, PF, ESIC, PT) and coordination with auditors and consultants
* Track cash flow and collections, and give leadership clear, timely financial reports

*Administration & People Management*

* Oversee HR operations: attendance, leave, payroll inputs, onboarding documentation and employee records
* Manage and mentor the admin and accounts staff, and build accountability across the team
* Act as a trusted, firm and fair point of contact for employee matters

**What Success Looks Like**

* Accounts are accurate, up to date and audit-ready at all times
* Collections are on track, and statutory deadlines are never missed
* The office runs on clear systems, not on firefighting
* Leadership can rely on you completely for finance, admin and office matters
* The team sees you as a respected, stable presence

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Post-graduate with a strong academic record (M.Com, MBA Finance or equivalent preferred)
* 80% or above in Class 10 (Matriculation)
* 10+ years of experience in accounts, administration and office management, including people management
* Experience managing a startup or a growing SME is a strong advantage
* Excellent written and spoken English
* A mature, stable and decisive personality, with integrity, discretion and the confidence to lead



**Why Join Us**

* A senior, trusted position that reports directly to the founder
* The opportunity to build and own systems in a growing organisation
* A purpose-driven company that helps take Indian manufacturing to the world

title: Senior Specialist, HR Services
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Specialist, HR Services
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a Senior Specialist, HR Services – Global Mobility (GBSC) to support end-to-end delivery of mobility services within a centralized shared services model.
  
  
This role is responsible for managing complex global mobility cases, ensuring compliance and policy adherence, and driving operational excellence across relocation, global immigration, and assignment processes.
  
  
The position plays a critical role in vendor coordination, and maintaining control, documentation, and audit readiness across mobility operations, while partnering closely with cross-functional stakeholders and our COE.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For**

* Strong understanding of:
* Global mobility policies and program management
* Global immigration support and relocation processes
* Experience in Global Mobility & HR Operations / Shared Services environment
* Proven ability to handle complex, sensitive, or escalated employee cases
* High attention to detail with a strong focus on accuracy, compliance, and risk awareness
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple cases/workstreams simultaneously
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience in data-driven decision making
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ownership mindset with ability to drive resolution independently while escalating appropriately when needed

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage complex, non-standard, and high-risk mobility cases across relocation, immigration, and assignment programs
* Support global mobility programs including relocation, immigration, international assignments, and policy-driven employee moves
* Deliver a high-quality employee experience by providing clear guidance on policies, processes, and mobility programs
* Ensure consistent application of policies across regions while managing exceptions and non-standard scenarios
* Partner with internal teams to ensure smooth execution across the employee lifecycle and global transitions
* Ensure adherence to mobility policies, regulatory requirements, and audit standards
* Collaborate with People Business Partners, Payroll, Legal, cross-functional teams and vendors to drive end-to-end case resolution
* Leverage data and reporting to identify trends, risks, and process improvements
* Manage vendor interactions related to mobility services, ensuring service delivery and issue resolution
* Maintain accuracy and governance in case management, documentation, and systems.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: HR Executive – HR Operations & HRMS
description:
**Location:**
Pune, Maharashtra / Halol, Gujarat

**Experience:**
2–4 Years

**Industry:**
Manufacturing / Engineering

**Altus Global Consulting**
is hiring HR professionals on behalf of one of its clients, an established engineering and manufacturing organisation.

We are looking for
**HR Executives – HR Operations & HRMS**
for the client's manufacturing locations in
**Pune and Halol**
. These positions will support day-to-day HR operations while playing an important role in the organisation's HRMS implementation, HR process improvement and standardisation initiatives.

This is a hands-on HR role suited to professionals who are comfortable working across HR operations, employee data management, attendance, payroll coordination, recruitment and statutory processes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate the implementation and ongoing administration of the organisation's HRMS.
* Maintain, validate and update employee master data and HR records.
* Manage employee lifecycle documentation covering joining, confirmation, transfers and separation.
* Monitor attendance, leave, absenteeism and related employee information.
* Prepare, verify and coordinate monthly payroll inputs.
* Coordinate with HRMS, payroll and other HR service providers for operational requirements.
* Support PF, ESIC, Professional Tax and other applicable statutory compliance activities.
* Coordinate manpower requirements with departmental stakeholders.
* Handle sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offers and joining formalities.
* Maintain employee personnel files and statutory documentation.
* Address routine employee queries relating to HR, attendance, leave and payroll.
* Prepare regular HR MIS covering headcount, attendance, attrition, recruitment and employee movements.
* Support the implementation of common HR processes, policies and documentation across locations.
* Coordinate with management and the central HR advisory team on ongoing HR initiatives.

**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for candidates with:

* **2–4 years of experience**
  in HR Operations / HR Generalist roles.
* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources preferred.
* Experience in
  **manufacturing, engineering or industrial organisations**
  preferred.
* Practical understanding of attendance, leave, payroll inputs and employee documentation.
* Exposure to HRMS / HRIS platforms.
* Basic knowledge of PF, ESIC and applicable statutory HR compliance.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel.
* Strong communication, coordination and documentation skills.
* Ability to independently manage routine HR activities at the location level.
* Willingness to work in an evolving environment where HR systems and processes are being progressively standardised.

**Role Development**

The role will initially have a strong focus on
**HR Operations and HRMS implementation**
. As systems and processes mature, the incumbent will progressively take responsibility for broader HR activities at the respective location.

**1 Position – Halol, Gujarat**

title: Chief Human Resources Officer
description:
**About MaxIQ**

**MaxIQ**
is a revenue intelligence platform that helps enterprise sales and customer success teams forecast accurately, inspect pipeline, and act on customer signals. We integrate with Salesforce, Snowflake and Gong, and our AI agents work on top of MaxIQ’s Context Graph. We’re a fast-growing team in Pune building for global enterprise customers.

**The Role**

We’re hiring our first senior people leader. You’ll build HR at MaxIQ from the ground up and also own finance and compliance operations for our India entity. This is a hands-on role: you’ll set the strategy and do the work, partnering directly with the founders and leadership.

**What You’ll Own**

* HR policies, employee handbook and statutory compliance (PF, ESI, PT, gratuity, POSH)
* Recruitment end to end, managing our in-house recruiter, plus exits and F&F settlements
* Employer branding content on culture, hiring and life at MaxIQ, in partnership with marketing
* Onboarding, employee engagement, team events, gifting and recognition
* Performance management, appraisals and career frameworks
* Compensation bands, increments, bonus planning, ESOP administration and monthly payroll
* Banking relationship, FIRC coordination, GST/TDS/ROC filings and statutory audit, working with our accountant and external CA
* Org structure, headcount planning and a monthly people dashboard for leadership
* SOC 2 and ISO 27001 compliance program management and people-side controls
* Employee wellbeing, retention, culture and L&D
* Advising founders on people and scaling decisions, and building a lean HR team as we grow

**What We’re Looking For**

* 10+ years in HR, with at least 3–4 years leading HR in a startup or product/SaaS company
* Strong working knowledge of Indian labour laws, payroll and statutory compliance
* Hands-on exposure to finance operations such as GST, TDS, banking and audits
* Experience setting up HR policies, processes and HRMS from scratch
* Exposure to SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audits is a strong plus
* A builder’s mindset: comfortable owning many areas without a large team
* Excellent communication and judgment, with the trust of both leadership and employees

**Why Join**

* Build the people function from day one at a high-growth AI company
* Direct partnership with founders and real ownership across HR, finance and compliance
* A sharp, collaborative team working on hard enterprise AI problems

title: HR Data & Insights Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
The HR Data & Insights Analyst is responsible for the development, governance, and delivery of HR reporting, dashboards, and workforce analytics solutions. This role will serve as the primary subject matter expert for Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence (OTBI), delivering actionable insights that support strategic workforce planning, talent management, compliance, payroll, and operational decision-making.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong technical reporting expertise with business acumen and a passion for transforming HR data into meaningful insights. Experience with Oracle HCM Cloud, OTBI dashboard development, and HR data is strongly preferred.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**
**Reporting & Dashboard Development**

* Design, build, maintain, and optimize OTBI analyses, dashboards, and reports across Oracle HCM Cloud.
* Develop executive-level dashboards and KPI scorecards for HR leadership and business stakeholders.
* Create standardized reporting packages for workforce, talent, recruiting, compensation, diversity, payroll, absence, and organizational metrics.
* Partner with HR and business leaders to gather requirements and translate them into reporting solutions.

**Analytics & Insights**

* Analyze workforce data and identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
* Deliver actionable insights on headcount, turnover, retention, hiring, internal mobility, workforce demographics, and organizational effectiveness.
* Support strategic workforce planning initiatives through predictive and trend analysis.
* Develop recurring and ad hoc analyses to support business decisions.

**Data Governance & Quality**

* Ensure data integrity and reporting accuracy across HR systems.
* Validate data sources and resolve discrepancies.
* Establish and maintain report documentation, data definitions, and governance standards.
* Collaborate with HRIS and IT teams to improve reporting processes and data quality.

**Stakeholder Support**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for HR reporting requests.
* Consult with leaders to determine meaningful metrics and reporting solutions.
* Train business users on dashboard functionality and self-service reporting capabilities.
* Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders at multiple organizational levels.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to automate reporting processes and reduce manual effort.
* Recommend enhancements to reporting capabilities and analytics tools.
* Stay current on Oracle HCM Cloud reporting functionality, OTBI enhancements, and industry best practices.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Statistics, Data Analytics, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in reporting, business intelligence, analytics, or HRIS-related roles.
* Advanced experience creating reports and dashboards using Oracle OTBI.
* Strong understanding of relational data concepts and reporting best practices.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Oracle HCM Cloud.
* Experience reporting across Human Resources, Recruiting, Talent Management, Compensation, Payroll, Time & Labor, or Benefits.
* Experience with Oracle BI Publisher.
* Experience building executive dashboards and KPI scorecards.
* Familiarity with workforce planning and HR analytics methodologies.
* Knowledge of data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Experience working in a global organization.

**Key Competencies**

* Analytical Thinking
* Data Storytelling
* Dashboard Design
* Business Partnership
* Attention to Detail
* Process Improvement
* Problem Solving
* Customer Focus
* Project Management

**Success Measures**

* Within the first year, this individual will:
* Establish themselves as the organization's OTBI reporting expert.
* Develop and maintain a portfolio of standardized HR dashboards.
* Improve reporting efficiency through automation and self-service capabilities.
* Increase leadership visibility to key workforce metrics and trends.
* Enhance data quality and reporting governance across HR systems.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys working with data, reporting, and analytics. This is not a general HRIS role. The successful candidate will spend the majority of their time building reports, creating dashboards, analyzing workforce trends, and advising stakeholders through data-driven insights. Oracle OTBI expertise is essential, while Oracle HCM Cloud and HR domain experience are highly desirable.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Role Summary

We are looking for an experienced HR Manager who will act as a generalist across both our India and US locations. You will oversee day-to-day HR operations, lead recruitment, and manage facilities, while staying hands-on with execution. This role suits someone who can set up good processes, handle the operational details themselves, and work across two countries and time zones with confidence.

Key Responsibilities

HR Operations and Compliance

* Manage the full employee lifecycle across both locations: onboarding, confirmations, transfers, separations, and exit formalities.
* Own payroll inputs, attendance, leave, and benefits administration in coordination with payroll providers or internal finance.
* Maintain employee records and HRIS data accurately, and ensure policies are current and consistently applied.
* Ensure compliance with local labour laws. In India, this includes PF, ESI, gratuity, professional tax, Shops and Establishments registrations, and POSH obligations. In the US, this includes federal and state employment requirements, I-9 verification, and benefits compliance
* Handle employee queries, grievances, and disciplinary matters in a fair, documented, and confidential manner.
* Prepare HR reports and dashboards (headcount, attrition, leave, compliance status) for leadership.

Recruitment

* Own end-to-end hiring for both locations: requisition intake, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer management, and joining formalities.
* Work with hiring managers to define role requirements and interview processes.
* Manage relationships with recruitment agencies, job boards, and campus or employer-branding channels.
* Track recruitment metrics such as time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, and offer acceptance rates.
* Support a consistent candidate experience across India and US hiring processes, including any cross-border hiring considerations.

Facilities and Workplace Administration

* Oversee office operations in both locations: space planning, seating, supplies, housekeeping, and maintenance.
* Manage vendor relationships and contracts for facilities services (housekeeping, security, pantry, AMC, utilities, courier, and similar).
* Coordinate workplace safety, fire and emergency drills, and statutory safety inspections as required.
* Manage the budget for facilities and admin, and track spend against it.
* Support travel, visa-related logistics, and coordination where needed.

Hands-On Generalist Work

* Handle HR queries and tasks directly rather than only delegating them.
* Support employee engagement initiatives, events, and recognition programs.
* Contribute to policy drafting and process improvement across both locations.
* Act as a point of coordination between the India and US teams on HR matters.

Qualifications

* Master’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 10 to 15 years of HR generalist experience, with at least 2 years in a managerial or lead role.
* Working knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance. Familiarity with US employment law and multi-state compliance is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in full-cycle recruitment, including for mid-level and senior roles.
* Experience managing facilities or admin functions, or coordinating vendors and budgets.
* Experience working with a team or stakeholders across more than one country.
* Proficiency with HRIS and payroll systems, and strong skills in Excel or Google Sheets.

Key Competencies

* Operational discipline: Keeps processes accurate, documented, and on schedule.
* Confidentiality and judgement: Handles sensitive employee matters with discretion and fairness.
* Cross-cultural communication: Works well with teams in different countries and time zones.
* Hands-on ownership: Takes tasks from start to finish without needing close supervision.
* Stakeholder management: Builds trust with employees, managers, and leadership.

Adaptability: Manages competing priorities in a growing organisation.

Kindly share your detaila at praveen.dighe@hwtglobal.com**

title: Crewing Manager (Ship Management)
description:
**1. Job Purpose**

To ensure effective and compliant management of seafarers assigned to the designated tanker fleet, maintaining high standards of crew competence, safety, operational readiness, and service delivery in accordance with applicable international regulations, Flag State and Oil Major requirements, and Crestline’s crewing standards.

The Crewing Manager oversees crew planning, recruitment, retention, deployment, certification, training compliance, travel coordination, and cost control to ensure a continuous supply of qualified and competent personnel across the assigned fleet.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

A. Crew Planning, Recruitment and Retention

* Recruit, select, and deploy suitably qualified officers and ratings in accordance with vessel-specific requirements and company standards.
* Develop and maintain crew rotation plans to ensure timely relief, adequate manpower availability, and uninterrupted vessel operations.
* Maintain a dedicated pool of competent seafarers, focusing on the retention of experienced officers and key personnel.
* Develop succession and career progression plans for senior officers, including Masters, Chief Engineers, Chief Officers, and Second Engineers.
* Maintain contact with officers during leave periods, as appropriate, to monitor availability, engagement, and future deployment.
* Identify crew shortages, retention risks, and succession gaps, implementing appropriate mitigation measures.
* Coordinate with approved manning agents to ensure timely sourcing and deployment of suitable personnel.

B. Regulatory Compliance, Certification and Training

* Ensure all crew joining assigned vessels hold valid certificates of competency and proficiency, medical certificates, visas, Flag State endorsements, and other required documentation.
* Maintain compliance with applicable STCW, MLC 2006, Flag State, Port State, and collective bargaining agreement (CBA) requirements.
* Review and maintain the crew training and competency matrix for each rank and vessel, ensuring compliance with company, shipowner, charterer, and applicable Oil Major requirements.
* Monitor certificate validity, endorsements, medical fitness, and mandatory training, ensuring timely renewals and completion.
* Verify crew qualifications and joining documentation before deployment.
* Coordinate tanker-specific training, familiarisation, and competency development with relevant departments.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date crew records in Shipmate.

C. Crew Travel and Deployment

* Arrange and coordinate crew sign-on and sign-off travel through appointed and approved marine travel providers.
* Ensure inbound and outbound travel is booked promptly and cost-effectively, considering vessel schedules, joining ports, visa requirements, and operational priorities.
* Manage travel changes and emergencies to minimise delays, additional costs, and operational disruption.
* Liaise with vessels, manning agents, travel providers, and internal departments to ensure smooth crew movements.

D. Crew Cost Control and Budget Management

* Prepare and maintain a rolling 12-month crew cost budget and rotation plan for the top four officers on each assigned vessel, aligned with fleet and key account requirements.
* Monitor monthly crew costs in Shipmate, identifying budget variances, cost trends, and savings opportunities.
* Submit monthly crew cost reports with variance analysis, explanatory comments, and corrective actions where required.
* Maintain accurate forecasts covering crew changes, salaries, travel, training, and other crewing expenses.
* Optimise costs without compromising crew quality, safety, regulatory compliance, or operational readiness.

E. Audit, Vetting and Operational Support

* Monitor crew-related audit and vetting performance and coordinate preparations for inspections and assessments.
* Work closely with Marine, Operations, Technical, and HSEQ Departments to address crew-related findings and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure crew qualifications, training records, and competency evidence are readily available and compliant.
* Monitor applicable Oil Major, charterer, and vessel-specific requirements to maintain operational eligibility.
* Visit assigned vessels whenever practicable, particularly when calling at Singapore, to engage with seafarers and address crew-related matters.

F. Crew Management Systems and Data Administration

* Ensure effective adoption and consistent use of Shipmate across all assigned crewing activities.
* Maintain ownership of crew data, rotation schedules, certificates, training records, and related documentation.
* Ensure crew movements, costs, and documentation status are accurately recorded and promptly updated in Shipmate.
* Improve system utilisation, reporting accuracy, and crewing administration efficiency.

G. Crew Welfare, Medical and Claims Administration

* Coordinate crew medical and P&I claims, ensuring supporting documentation is complete and submitted promptly.
* Liaise with internal departments, insurers, P&I correspondents, and medical providers on crew-related claims.
* Support the handling of crew welfare concerns, grievances, and disciplinary matters in accordance with company policies and applicable requirements.
* Maintain appropriate communication with seafarers to facilitate timely resolution of personnel matters.

H. Manning Agent Management and Performance

* Conduct periodic visits and performance reviews of approved manning agents.
* Conduct or coordinate audits covering recruitment practices, crew qualifications, certification, documentation, and regulatory compliance.
* Monitor agent performance in crew quality, availability, retention, responsiveness, and cost effectiveness.
* Document audit findings, agree corrective actions, and ensure timely follow-up.
* Maintain effective working relationships with manning agents to ensure reliable crew supply and continuity across the assigned fleet.

**Requirements:**

* Relevant maritime qualification, degree, or professional certification in maritime studies, crewing, human resources, or a related discipline.
* Substantial crew management experience in commercial shipping, preferably involving oil, gas, chemical, or product tankers.
* Sound knowledge of STCW, MLC 2006, Flag State requirements, tanker-specific training, crew certification, and applicable CBAs.
* Proven experience in crew planning, recruitment, retention, budgeting, and manning agent management.
* Familiarity with Oil Major vetting requirements and tanker crew competency standards.
* Experience with Shipmate or similar crew management systems.
* Strong organisational, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage competing operational priorities.

title: Vice President, Payroll
description:
**Job Description**
We’re seeking a future team member for the role of
***Vice President, Payroll***
to join our
***Payroll –***
***Time and Attendance***
. This role is located in
***Pune.***
**In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:**
**Position Summary:**
The Vice President, Global Time and Attendance, will lead the strategy, governance, and end-to-end delivery of Time, Labor, and Absence services across multiple countries. The role requires deep subject matter expertise, strong people and operational leadership, and the ability to influence senior leaders, works councils, vendors, technology partners, payroll teams, and country stakeholders. The successful candidate will ensure accurate, compliant, and reliable time and attendance outcomes while advancing process standardization, system capability, control effectiveness, and employee experience.
  
  

* Functional strategy and governance: Define the global Time and Attendance strategy, service model, governance framework, standards, and roadmap in alignment with People, Payroll, Finance, Risk, Legal, and Technology priorities.
* Subject matter leadership: Serve as the senior authority for time capture, work schedules, overtime, premiums, leave and absence interfaces, exception management, approvals, manager hierarchies, and downstream payroll impacts.
* Multi-country operations: Lead delivery across complex geographies, ensuring consistent controls and service standards while accommodating local legislation, collective labor arrangements, working-time requirements, and country-specific practices.
* Compliance and risk: Maintain compliance with labor laws, working-time regulations, shop agreements, internal policies, audit requirements, record-retention standards, and payroll control expectations; proactively identify and mitigate operational and regulatory risks.
* Works council engagement: Partner with Employee Relations, Legal, and local leadership to prepare and support works council consultations, information requirements, approvals, and implementation of policy or system changes.
* Stakeholder leadership: Build trusted relationships with senior leaders, country People teams, Payroll, Technology, Finance, Risk, Legal, managers, and employees; provide clear decisions, executive updates, and escalation leadership.
* Vendor management: Own vendor governance, service performance, contractual obligations, issue escalation, root-cause resolution, change delivery, and continuous improvement across external service and technology providers.
* Technology and change: Govern the functional design, configuration, testing, user acceptance, release readiness, and adoption of Time and Attendance platforms and integrations, including interfaces to payroll and workforce systems.
* Operational performance: Establish and monitor service levels, controls, ticket volumes, backlogs, ageing, accuracy, timeliness, and customer experience metrics; drive corrective actions and sustainable improvement.
* Transformation: Simplify and standardize processes, identify automation opportunities, strengthen data quality, and lead implementation of global and country-specific enhancements.
* People leadership: Build, develop, and retain a high-performing global team; set clear accountabilities, strengthen subject matter capability, and foster an inclusive, collaborative, and control-focused culture.
* Business continuity: Maintain resilient operations through capacity planning, cross-training, documented procedures, contingency arrangements, and effective management of critical incidents.

**To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:**

* Significant experience leading Time and Attendance, Time and Labor, Workforce Management, Payroll, HR Operations, or a closely related global function.
* Deep knowledge of timekeeping processes, working-time rules, absence interactions, payroll dependencies, compliance controls, and employee data management.
* Demonstrated leadership of multi-country operations and complex stakeholder groups across different regulatory and cultural environments.
* Proven experience engaging works councils, employee representative bodies, Legal, Employee Relations, and country leadership on policy, process, or technology change.
* Strong vendor-management experience, including performance governance, commercial oversight, escalations, service recovery, and change delivery.
* Experience with enterprise Time and Attendance platforms, payroll integrations, functional design, testing, implementation, and production support; exposure to tools such as SAP Fiori or Oracle is advantageous.
* Strong executive communication, influencing, negotiation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Demonstrated ability to lead global teams, manage competing priorities, and deliver measurable improvements in service, risk, cost, and employee experience.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience; relevant HR, payroll, workforce management, project, or risk qualifications are preferred.

title: Reporting Analyst, Workday Reporting
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
  
  
**About The Team**
The People & Purpose Reporting Services Analyst will be a key member of the People Operations team, providing Workday Reporting support for all employees Join our People & Purpose Reporting Services team, part of People Operations, where we help every employee and manager across Workday get the data they need. We work side-by-side with our People & Purpose Centers of Excellence — Recruiting, Talent Experience, Total Rewards, HR Partners, Learning, Compliance, Belonging and Diversity, and Global Mobility — to close gaps in data and build reports that help our leaders make informed, real-time decisions. We also build self-service tools so our partners can find answers faster on their own. If you enjoy connecting the dots across many parts of HR and turning complex data into something people can act on, you'll feel right at home here.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a
**Reporting Analyst**
, you will be the person people turn to when they need HR data they can rely on, whether that's building a new report, updating an existing one, or digging into a one-off question. You will own high-impact, ad-hoc reporting requests from start to finish, helping requesters shape raw data into a clear story they can bring to their own audience. This role touches nearly every area of HR, including recruiting, compensation, diversity, learning, talent, audits, compliance, and transfers, so you will build broad knowledge of how HR data connects across the business. You will also look for ways to make reporting simpler and more enjoyable for everyone who relies on it.
  
  
In this role, you will:
  
  

* Respond to HR data requests spanning recruiting, compensation, diversity, learning, talent, audits, compliance, and transfers
* Be responsible for audits requested by any team across the business, ensuring the underlying data is accurate, complete, and compliant
* Build new reports and update or troubleshoot existing ones in Workday
* Provide attentive, high-touch support for high-impact, ad-hoc reporting requests, helping requesters interpret and present their data
* Apply strong data security, accuracy, governance, and standardization practices to every report you deliver
* Prioritize and manage a high volume of requests with competing deadlines
* Create self-service resources that help HR partners find answers faster on their own

**About You**
**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience in HR reporting, analytics, or a related data role
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining reports in Workday Reporting (Workday HCM experience is a plus)

**Other Qualifications**

* Able to turn complex HR data into a clear story that helps business leaders make decisions
* Skilled at cleaning, organizing, and combining data from multiple HR systems, with strong attention to data security, accuracy, and governance
* Broad knowledge of HR functions and terminology across areas such as recruiting, total rewards, learning, and compliance
* Attentive and responsive when supporting internal customers, even under tight deadlines
* Organized and able to juggle multiple requests and deadlines in a high-volume environment

**Our Approach to Flexible Work**
With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply
**spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field**
with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.
  
  
Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision-making to any degree. Please see below for more details including how to request an accommodation as a qualified veteran, due to a disability or for religious reasons, or as otherwise provided under applicable law.
  
  
Workday prohibits taking adverse action against any candidate or employee for reporting a possible violation of this policy, requesting one or more work accommodations, exercising a privacy right, or cooperating in an investigation in accordance with applicable law. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law.
  
  
If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com, as far in advance as possible.
