title: Careline Lead, Asia & METSA
description:
**Life tastes better with ice cream**
With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.
  
  
We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.
  
  
**What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work.**
We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.
  
  
We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.
  
  
ABOUT ICE CREAM: Life Tastes Better with Ice Cream Once separated from Unilever, the The Magnum Ice Cream Company (TMICC) will become the world’s largest global Ice Cream Company, with over 100 years’ experience delivering a diverse range of indulgent, yet responsible, craft food experiences. We have 35 brands, including 3 one billion Euro brands (Magnum, Wall’s, Ben & Jerry’s), a strong presence in over 60 countries, generating annual revenue of €8 billion. All brands are driven to transform moments into memories through indulgent yet responsibly made and marketed products. We have a well-developed strategy to deliver growth and value creation which is clear on where to play and how to win. We turn the ordinary into the extraordinary by designing unique and innovative Ice Cream experiences that make life taste better, creating joyful experiences. In our Ice Cream business, we’re crafting the future through innovation and imaginative minds, creating unique products. We spark moments of happiness for people and within the communities where we operate. We are committed to developing and nurturing talent. You will have ample options for career growth and exploration. Your career development will be a priority for us, and we are dedicated to supporting your growth journey within the new company. ABOUT GBS: Global Business Solutions:   Global Business Solutions (GBS) is TMICC’s trusted transformation partner, delivering innovative and integrated solutions from design to delivery. We develop future-fit capability, expertise and technologically advanced solutions to unlock speed, simplicity and operational agility across TMICCs operations. This is your chance for a ‘once in a lifetime’ career experience, playing a part in the creation of a fully independent, new Ice Cream company and a greenfield GBS organization supporting Europe Supply Chain Finance Processes. Employees within GBS partner with multiple teams in countries across Europe ranging from Factories, Distribution Centers, Supply Chain Planning, Customer Services, Procurement. You will become part of the delivery service engine behind TMICC’s hero brands and will have the opportunity to implement new solutions and processes alongside an innovative tech stack that is been delivered as part of the separation from Unilever program. What you'll be responsible for Act as the primary point of contact between GBS Careline teams (Captive and/or 3PSP) and markets within the region (BU). Act as an additional layer of supervision of work performed by 3rd party vendor for daily services. Serve as the escalation point for operational risks, delays, or service failures, and coordinate crisis management, ensuring timely resolution and transparent communication. Ensure Careline operations consistently follow TMICC global standards, processes, tools, timelines, communications, validating consistent implementation across the region. Monitor and govern region-level Careline operations performance using dashboards and reports, ensuring service delivery meets agreed SLAs, KPIs, and quality standards. Identify trends, risks, and root causes of underperformance, drive corrective actions, and promote continuous improvement across the region. Support markets during transitions, onboarding, and operating model changes, ensuring awareness, readiness, and alignment between the operations and local market requirements. Hold accountability for region-level budget governance, including vendor cost tracking, volume forecasting alignment, and identification of cost optimization opportunities. Manage stakeholder relationships across internal teams (Marketing, Legal, Supply Chain, Quality) and external partners, ensuring alignment on priorities, timelines, and deliverables at the regional level. We're looking for someone who Practical experience in Consumer or Customer Engagement operations, with understanding of customer care processes, performance KPIs, and quality standards. Exposure to governance, coordination, or oversight roles within GBS, shared services, BPO, or complex multi market environment Team Manager experience in supervising team members (direct or 3rd party BPO). Ability to work across multiple countries or markets, supporting alignment with global standards, processes, and timelines. Experience supporting or coordinating transitions, operating model changes, or transformations, with a strong understanding of readiness, governance, and escalation. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to review performance dashboards, identify trends and risks, and drive follow up actions through stakeholders. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, combined with a high ownership mindset and confidence to challenge and escalate where required. What you'll get Alongside meaningful work and strong development, we offer a reward package that typically includes Market-competitive pay and performance related rewards Flexible ways of working Support for health, wellbeing and life outside of work Time off to rest and recharge Ongoing learning and development opportunities Specific benefits vary by location
  
  
**Why join us?**
This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!
  
  
You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.
  
  

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.

Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.
  
  
**Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?**
If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.
  
  
If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.

title: Assistant Manager Human Resources
description:
**Company Description**
Dyna-K Automotive Stampings Private Limited, founded in December 1985, specializes in precision stampings, pressed components, and assemblies for the automotive industry. Over time, the company has expanded its capabilities to serve multiple automotive sectors, producing critical safety components for seats, suspensions, axles, turbochargers, and more. Dyna-K operates two plants with approximately 52,000 sq. ft. of workshop space in the Pune MIDC Industrial Area, supported by in-house tool design and manufacturing. As a TS 16949 certified quality organization, Dyna-K is committed to meeting and exceeding customer expectations through reliable production and continuous improvement.

**Role Description**

To manage and ensure effective implementation of Human Resources activities, Statutory (FACTORY ACT , BONUS and wages act) and Labour law compliance, IATF 16949 requirements, Employee documentation, and regulatory return filings at the manufacturing plant.

The role requires hands-on experience in a factory environment, with strong knowledge of applicable labour legislation, statutory registers, inspections, audits, and HR processes.

**Manufacturing industry experience is mandatory.**

Key Responsibilities

**A. Statutory Factory Act & Labour Law Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, statutory regulations, and government notifications relevant to the manufacturing establishment.
* Maintain compliance with applicable provisions relating to factory operations, working hours, attendance, overtime, leave, wages, holidays, and employment conditions.
* Handle applicable requirements under the Factories Act, 1948, and relevant Maharashtra factory rules, as applicable to the establishment.
* Coordinate with government departments, labour authorities, inspectors, consultants, and external agencies during inspections and compliance reviews.
* Track changes in labour legislation and ensure timely implementation of applicable requirements.

**B. IATF 16949 & QMS Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable HR-related requirements of IATF 16949 and the organisation’s Quality Management System.
* Maintain employee competence, qualification, skill matrix, training, awareness, and competency evaluation records.
* Coordinate internal audits, external audits, customer audits, and certification audits concerning HR and training processes.

**C. HR Documentation & Record Management**

* Maintain employee personal files, appointment letters, employment contracts, confirmation letters, amendments, and separation records.Ensure accurate documentation of attendance, leave, overtime, payroll inputs, wage records, and employee letters
* Ensure systematic digital and physical record management, with documents maintained in designated locations and readily available for audits.

**D. Factory HR Operations**

* Manage day-to-day HR activities in a manufacturing environment, including attendance, leave, shift records, overtime, employee deployment, and workforce administration.
* Coordinate with production and department heads on manpower requirements, employee discipline, absenteeism, and workforce availability.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, induction, employee confirmation, performance management, and separation processes.
* Coordinate employee training, skill development, statutory awareness, safety training, and training effectiveness records.

**E. Compliance Monitoring & Reporting**

* Prepare and maintain a statutory compliance calendar covering due dates, periodic returns, renewals, and inspections.
* Prepare monthly HR and compliance MIS for management review.

Educational Qualification

* Graduate in HR, Human Resources Management, Labour Welfare, Commerce, or a related discipline.
* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or a qualification in Labour Laws will be an added advantage.

Experience Required

* **Minimum 5–8 years of relevant experience in HR and statutory compliance in a manufacturing / factory environment.**
* **Hands-on experience in statutory compliance, labour law documentation, statutory return filing, and factory-related compliance is essential.**
* **Prior experience in the automotive or auto-component manufacturing industry will be preferred.**
* **Experience handling IATF 16949 audits and HR-related QMS documentation is highly desirable.**
* **Candidates with only general HR, recruitment, or office administration experience without factory statutory compliance exposure should not be considered.**

title: Human Resources Director
description:
**Company Description**
Power Works Engineering specializes in the manufacturing, engineering, design, and supply of flow control equipment and piping systems for nuclear power plants.

**HR Director (HRD)**

**Manufacturing | Maharashtra, India**

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced HR Director to build and lead the HR and administration function for a new valve manufacturing facility in India.

You will define the people strategy, build the workforce, and establish the policies, systems, and compliance framework required for plant launch and long-term operations. The role combines strategic leadership with direct operational responsibility during the initial stages.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **HR strategy & workforce planning:**

  Translate business and production plans into workforce requirements, organizational structure, and manpower budgets.
* **Recruitment & onboarding:**

  Lead hiring across engineering, production, quality, technical, and administrative roles. Build recruitment partnerships, apprenticeship programmes, and effective onboarding.
* **Compliance & employee relations:**

  Oversee labour and statutory compliance, contractor obligations, employee relations, grievance handling, and disciplinary processes.
* **Compensation & HR operations:**

  Establish salary structures, benefits, payroll controls, and systems for employee records, attendance, and leave.
* **Performance & development:**

  Implement performance management, KPIs, training, and competency management aligned with business needs and applicable ISO requirements.
* **Culture & engagement:**

  Build a culture of safety, accountability, quality, and continuous improvement.
* **Plant administration:**

  Oversee facilities support, security, housekeeping, canteen, transport, administrative vendors, and related budgets. Coordinate expatriate support where required.

**Candidate Requirements**

* 10+ years of progressive HR experience, including leadership responsibility in manufacturing or industrial facilities in India.
* Proven ability to establish or scale HR functions, policies, and systems.
* Strong expertise in Indian labour legislation, plant-level statutory compliance, industrial relations, and contract labour management.
* Demonstrated experience recruiting engineering professionals, production teams, and skilled workers.
* Experience managing HR budgets, compensation, payroll, and performance processes.
* Experience in an international organization with structured governance and reporting.
* Familiarity with competency management and HR requirements in ISO-certified or audited environments.
* Strong business judgment, stakeholder management skills, and willingness to work hands-on.
* Fluency in English and Marathi.

**Preferred:**

Greenfield plant experience; background in engineering, energy, nuclear, oil & gas, aerospace, or other quality-regulated industries; experience supporting expatriates; employee training experience; relevant degree or postgraduate qualification.

**What We Offer**

The opportunity to shape the plant’s people strategy and build its HR function from the ground up, working with international management from project launch through full-scale operations.

**How to Apply**

Please send your CV to info@pwe-uae.com with the subject line
**“HR Director — [Your Name]”**

.

In your email, briefly describe one example of an HR function or key HR process you personally built or significantly improved. Please include:

* The business challenge and scale of the organization.
* Your specific role and actions.
* The measurable results achieved.

Please keep your response to
**150–200 words**

.

title: Senior Total Rewards Specialist
description:
**Location: Pune, India (Work from home)**
**Role Overview**
Convera is seeking a Senior Total Rewards Specialist to support and enhance our global Total Rewards programs through a combination of benefits administration, compensation support, and employee engagement initiatives. Reporting into the Total Rewards team, you will play a key role in the day-to-day management of international benefits programs, global leave processes, vendor relationships, invoicing, and compensation activities.
  
  
You will also contribute to the design and implementation of benefits, retirement, wellbeing, and compensation initiatives, including market benchmarking, pay analysis, and annual compensation cycles. This is a broad, hands-on role split between compensation and benefits. You will support the development and application of Total Rewards frameworks, analyse data, coordinate core processes, and make practical recommendations for review by senior members of the team. As part of a global function, you will partner with cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate program effectiveness, ensure compliance, improve processes, and increase employee awareness and engagement with our Total Rewards offerings.
  
  
**Compensation**
**You will be responsible for:**

* Supporting compensation processes and projects, including market benchmarking, pay range analysis, annual compensation planning, and the preparation of materials to inform reward decisions.
* Conducting market pricing and benchmarking using compensation survey data and established internal methodologies.
* Supporting participation in external compensation surveys and maintaining accurate market benchmark information.
* Analysing employee pay, salary ranges, compa-ratios, range position, internal equity, and market competitiveness to identify trends and exceptions.
* Supporting annual compensation cycles, including merit reviews, promotions, salary adjustments, and incentive planning.
* Preparing compensation reports, models, and presentation materials to support recommendations and decision-making.
* Conducting job matching, job evaluation, and job grading activities using established methodologies, preparing recommendations, supporting governance reviews as required, and escalating complex or unusual cases for review.
* Partnering with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, and Finance to respond to compensation queries and provide data-based guidance within established frameworks.
* Maintaining compensation documentation, process guides, pay ranges, and supporting controls to promote accurate and consistent application.
* Contributing data and analysis to pay equity, pay transparency, and regulatory reporting projects.

**Benefits, Wellbeing & Leave**

* Managing and overseeing the day-to-day operations of international benefits programs.
* Playing a key role in the design and implementation of benefits, retirement, and wellbeing initiatives that reflect company values and address employees' needs at every stage of life.
* Managing global leave of absence programs, ensuring compliance, accuracy, and clear communication with stakeholders.
* Building and maintaining effective relationships with vendors, brokers, consultants, and internal stakeholders to ensure compliance with regulations and company policies.
* Supporting benefit renewals, market reviews, implementations, and plan changes by coordinating data, timelines, testing, and stakeholder actions.
* Leading project plans and timelines for the implementation of programs and plan design enhancements.
* Utilising analytical skills to evaluate program utilisation, cost, employee feedback, and market practice, identifying trends and recommending practical improvements.
* Developing and delivering organisation-wide communications to inform employees and stakeholders about program updates and changes.
* Managing benefits invoicing and payment processes, ensuring accuracy and timely completion.
* Maintaining benefits documentation, provider information, process guides, and employee-facing materials to support accurate and consistent delivery.

**Shared Total Rewards Delivery**

* Coordinating and delivering Total Rewards projects and workstreams from planning through implementation, including developing project plans, coordinating stakeholders, tracking actions, identifying risks and dependencies, and monitoring delivery against agreed timelines.
* Partnering with HR Business Partners to deliver Total Rewards initiatives, gathering and incorporating their business and employee insights to help shape practical, relevant, and scalable solutions.
* Responding to employee and stakeholder queries, resolving routine issues independently and escalating complex matters appropriately.
* Ensuring compensation and benefits data is accurate, confidential, and handled in line with company policies and applicable requirements.
* Identifying opportunities to simplify, document, and improve Total Rewards processes and employee experience.
* Collaborating with HR, Finance, Payroll, Legal, Procurement, and external partners to deliver accurate and timely outcomes.
* Keeping abreast of legislative and regulatory changes, and delivering changes to programmes to maintain compliance.

**You Should Apply If You Have**

* Relevant experience in a compensation, benefits, or broader Total Rewards role, with practical exposure to both compensation and benefits activities.
* Working knowledge of compensation principles, including market benchmarking, salary ranges, pay positioning, internal equity, and annual compensation cycles.
* Experience supporting employee benefits programs, renewals, vendors, communications, or administration, ideally across more than one country.
* Strong analytical and numerical capability, with the ability to interpret data, identify issues, and present clear findings.
* Strong Excel skills and confidence working with large or detailed datasets.
* Experience using compensation survey data from providers such as Aon, Mercer, WTW, Korn Ferry, or similar is desirable.
* Strong project management skills, with experience developing plans, coordinating stakeholders, managing timelines, tracking actions, and identifying risks or dependencies.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage recurring processes, deadlines, and multiple priorities accurately.
* Practical experience of job evaluation, job grading, job matching, or role levelling using an established methodology or framework.
* Ability to build effective partnerships with HR Business Partners, translate their input into Total Rewards requirements, and support the delivery of initiatives that respond to business and employee needs.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to work effectively with employees, HR colleagues, vendors, and other stakeholders.
* A practical, collaborative approach, with sound judgement about when to resolve an issue and when to escalate it.
* Experience working in an international, financial services, fintech, technology, or fast-paced environment is desirable.

**About Convera**
Convera is the largest non-bank B2B cross-border payments company in the world. Formerly Western Union Business Solutions, we leverage decades of industry expertise and technology-led payment solutions to deliver smarter money movements to our customers – helping them capture more value with every transaction. Convera serves more than 30,000 customers ranging from small business owners to enterprise treasurers to educational institutions to financial institutions to law firms to NGOs. Our teams care deeply about the value we bring to our customers, which makes Convera a rewarding place to work. This is an exciting time for our organization as we build our team with growth-minded, result-oriented people who are looking to move fast in an innovative environment. As a truly global company with employees in over 20 countries, we are passionate about diversity; we seek and celebrate people from different backgrounds, lifestyles, and unique points of view. We want to work with the best people and ensure we foster a culture of inclusion and belonging.
  
  
**We offer an abundance of competitive perks and benefits including:**

* Competitive salary
* Opportunity to earn an annual bonus.
* Great career growth and development opportunities in a global organization
* A flexible approach to work

There are plenty of amazing opportunities at Convera for talented, creative problem solvers who never settle for good enough and are looking to transform Business to Business payments. Apply now if you’re ready to unleash your potential.

In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People eXperience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. The Associate Partner role focuses on fundamental HR processes and direct employee support.
  
  
The Associate Partner delivers exceptional people experiences by leveraging both human expertise and technology solutions. They manage essential HR transactions while building meaningful connections with employees in an increasingly digital workplace. This role complements Amazon's evolving PXT service channels by providing personalized human support where it's most valuable. By effectively balancing technology-assisted processes with meaningful interaction, they help deliver a seamless PXT experience that furthers Amazon's commitment to being Earth's Best Employer.
  
  
As an Associate Partner in the PXT team, you will support the delivery of an exemplary employee experience through every interaction. This role requires maintaining a welcoming presence while providing accurate and timely support on benefits, policy, and payroll topics. You'll help build trust with employees while developing core HR capabilities and learning to handle sensitive information with appropriate confidentiality.
  
  
You will be expected to work onsite at an Amazon facility.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Deliver responsive, friendly, and professional support to employees across various channels (in-person, email, phone), providing accurate and timely information on benefits, policies, payroll, and other HR-related topics.
* Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and confidentiality of employee data by maintaining and processing records in a timely and secure manner.
* Contribute to a positive and inclusive workplace culture by supporting and implementing employee engagement and recognition initiatives, including planning and executing events that foster connection and celebrate achievements.
* Support data-driven decision making by collecting, reviewing, and analyzing key workforce metrics, including attendance, attrition, and engagement.

* Identify and escalate complex or sensitive issues to the appropriate HR and business leaders—such as leave of absence requests, workplace accommodations, and employee relations matters.

A day in the life
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
A typical day involves virtually helping employees navigate our digital HR tools and self-service platforms while providing responsive, professional support when needed. You'll spend time working through multiple business line HR case and appeal queues, answering questions about policies and programs, and identifying opportunities to improve self-service adoption. Working under guidance from senior team members, you'll ensure accurate data entry and documentation while delivering exceptional service that builds trust and confidence.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of human resources experience

title: People Relations Partner
description:
Castrol is one of the world’s leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company’s commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on roads and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years.
  
  
Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol.
  
  
**Job Description**
About the team
  
  
The People Relations team enables fair, consistent and legally compliant people practices while supporting business transformation. The team partners with P&C, Legal, Compliance, business leaders, employee representatives, unions and external advisers to manage complex employee and labour relations matters across the organisation.
  
  
Based in Pune within Castrol P&C team, this role reports to the Head of People Relations and acts as the organisation's employee and industrial relations expert for India. The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on oversight of complex cases, negotiations and workforce change.
  
  
Key tasks
  
  

* Develop the employee and labour relations strategy for India, establish governance frameworks and drive consistent, high-quality practices.
* Support and guide business partnering teams with complex and sensitive employee relations cases, including misconduct, ethics concerns, conflicts of interest, retaliation allegations, harassment complaints, grievances, disciplinary actions, executive investigations and whistleblowing matters by guiding partnering teams.

title: AVP / Manager, People Operations
description:
**Company Description**
As a leading global investment management firm, AB fosters diverse perspectives and embraces innovation to help our clients navigate the uncertainty of capital markets. Through high-quality research and diversified investment services, we serve institutions, individuals, and private wealth clients in major markets worldwide. Our ambition is simple: to be our clients’ most valued asset-management partner.
  
  
**Manager, People Operations**
As Manager, People Operations, you will lead a team that delivers timely, accurate, and compliant support across employee inquiries and core People processes. This role will help centralize and streamline global support by assessing current work, driving consistent ways of working, and translating the needs of People teams into scalable day-to-day execution. The ideal candidate is a hands-on HR Operations generalist who has developed within a centralized service environment and brings direct expertise in multiple specialized support areas. You will oversee daily operations, build team capability, strengthen service standards, and lead the team through growth, change, process transitions, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team that supports both specialized HR administration and generalized employee lifecycle support across U.S., EMEA, and evolving global service needs.
* Provide hands-on operational leadership across benefits administration, global mobility and immigration, time off and leave administration, and vendor management support, while ensuring effective delivery of broader People services.
* Help shape and implement the future-state service delivery model by assessing current work, defining the appropriate scope for centralized support, establishing workflows, clarifying ownership, and reinforcing consistent service standards.
* Oversee day-to-day team operations, including intake, workload balancing, case prioritization, and service continuity across a growing and changing portfolio of work.
* Monitor productivity, service quality, and operational performance; identify trends, gaps, and process issues, and take action to improve outcomes and reduce risk.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for complex or sensitive employee matters, exercising sound judgment to resolve issues independently where appropriate and escalating risk, policy, or stakeholder concerns when needed.
* Ensure accurate and compliant execution through quality reviews, adherence to policies and standard operating procedures, internal controls, audit readiness, and timely corrective action.
* Maintain clear, current process documentation and standard operating procedures, particularly as work transitions into the centralized team or expands across regions.
* Build team capability through ongoing coaching, cross-training, structured knowledge transfers, and day-to-day guidance that reinforces accountability, responsiveness, and consistent service.
* Partner closely with People Business Partners, Payroll, Benefits, Legal and other key stakeholders to resolve cross-functional issues, improve handoffs, and support smooth execution of People processes.
* Use data and operational insights to identify recurring issues, capacity constraints, and service trends, and translate findings into actionable recommendations that improve efficiency, consistency, and service quality.
* Identify opportunities to standardize, streamline, and automate manual processes, improve team tools and documentation, and support the continued centralization of key People functions.
* Lead the team through process transitions, policy or system changes, and service expansion while maintaining continuity, quality, and stakeholder confidence

**What We're Looking For**

* 5+ years of progressive experience in Human Resources Operations, Shared Services, Employee Services, or a similar centralized service environment, including experience executing processes on behalf of internal stakeholders and hands-on responsibility for complex employee lifecycle work in a fast-paced organization.
* Direct experience in at least two of the following specialized areas within the U.S. and/or EMEA: benefits administration, global mobility/immigration, time off and leave of absence administration, or vendor management support. Benefits administration experience is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated leadership experience, including direct supervision, coaching, performance management, cross-training, and development of teams operating in a high-volume service environment supporting high-touch employee populations.
* Working knowledge of compliance, controls, documentation, and risk considerations associated with HR administration across the U.S. and/or EMEA.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build credibility, influence decisions, and work effectively across multiple levels of the organization.
* Sound operational judgment and discretion, with the ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, handle sensitive employee matters and escalations with accuracy and confidentiality, and escalate issues involving risk, policy, or broader stakeholder impact.
* Strong analytical and process improvement skills, including experience using operational data to identify trends, assess capacity, determine root causes, and recommend scalable solutions.
* Experience using HRIS, case management, and workflow tools to support operational effectiveness; advanced familiarity with Workday is strongly preferred.
* Ability to operate effectively in a globally connected, U.S.-based corporate environment, balancing regional requirements with consistent service standards and scalable ways of working.

title: Learning & Organizational Development Manager
description:
**Thornton Tomasetti**
applies engineering and scientific principles to solve the world’s challenges. An independent organization of creative thinkers and innovative doers collaborating from offices worldwide, our mission is to bring our clients' ideas to life and, in the process, lay the groundwork for a better, more resilient future. We provide support and opportunities to our employees to achieve their full potential and cultivate a rewarding career.
  
  
**Your Role**
A commitment to challenging our people to grow, coupled with our inherent curiosity, drives Thornton Tomasetti to be a learning organization and, increasingly, a teaching one. Recognizing that most growth comes through active engagement in on-the-job experiences, proactive independent learning, and relationships, our Learning and Organizational Development (L+OD) group focuses on shortening learning curves and helping to create common frameworks across the organization related to four major skillsets: Technical, Management, Winning Work, and Leadership. We often provide resources, structure, additional scaffolding, logistical coordination, and other support to empower TT staff to teach/coach/mentor and learn-from one another. In our work, we emphasize curiosity, collaboration, and continuous improvement in the efficiency, effectiveness, and scalability of our programs through innovation.
  
  
The Learning and Organizational Development Manager will support our staff around the globe in accelerating their growth to more fully reach their potential as well-rounded professionals, with a particular focus on our rapidly growing presence in Asia (India, Vietnam, Australia, etc.). The person in this role will report to the Director of Learning and Organizational Development and collaborate closely with a wide range of staff around the world including program participants, subject matter experts, program executive sponsors, firm matrix leaders, and other members of Human Resources team.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Holistically manage learning programs aligned with the firm’s global efforts and vision, including conducting needs assessments, aligning learning objectives with business needs, partnering with subject matter experts, leading team members, and collaborating across stakeholder groups.
* Lead the design, development, assessment, and continuous improvement of learning collateral across modalities including customizing material for specific audiences, documenting procedures, reviewing others’ work, and serving as a liaison with continuing education accreditation organizations.
* Deliver exceptional learning experiences through a combination of facilitation, moderation, publication, and train-the-trainer efforts across programs.
* Manage content, data, and processes in the firm-wide Workday learning management system.
* Provide logistical, data management and analysis, and administrative support for programs.
* Complete other tasks as assigned.

**What You'll Bring**

* Degree (Master’s preferred) in education or a related field.
* 8+ years of progressive learning and development experience including instructional design, use of adult learning theories, delivering training, managing learning programs, train-the-trainer efforts, people management, and influencing senior leaders.
* Significant experience collaborating with people both in India and internationally, preferably within complex global organizations and professional services contexts.
* Strong project management, stakeholder management, and change management skills with the ability to balance long-term vision with operational execution.
* Excellent communication (written and verbal), collaboration, cultural awareness, emotional intelligence (self-management, relationship management, empathy, influence), adaptability, development of trusting relationships, and professional presence.
* Adaptability to participate in real-time communications and activities with team members in the United States and around the globe.
* Proficient at data management/analysis and with Microsoft productivity applications.

title: System Expert VNDLY
description:
**Life tastes better with ice cream**
With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.
  
  
We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.
  
  
**What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work.**
We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.
  
  
We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.
  
  
The role We are building a best-in-class HR Technology landscape to support the future of the Ice Cream Company. This role acts as the functional and technical expert for VNDLY, our contingent workforce management platform, ensuring it is stable, compliant, and continuously optimized to support our global contingent workforce. The role will own the end-to-end VNDLY solution, covering vendor management, contingent worker lifecycle, integrations with Workday and downstream systems, and ongoing enhancements. It plays a critical role in enabling a seamless, compliant, and scalable external workforce model across all markets. What you'll be responsible for Own and manage the VNDLY platform as a global HR Technology subject matter expert. Manage VNDLY configuration, workflows, data structures, access roles, system performance, and roadmap alignment. Support the complete contingent workforce lifecycle: requisition, onboarding, time tracking, invoicing, and offboarding. Drive process standardization and best practices across global markets. Manage integrations between VNDLY, Workday Core HCM, Finance/invoicing systems, and reporting platforms. Ensure data accuracy, system connectivity, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis for integration issues. Act as the key link between business stakeholders and AMS partners for operational support. Manage incidents, service requests, enhancements, SLAs, and continuous improvements. Identify and implement VNDLY process improvements, automation opportunities, and user experience enhancements. Support release management activities, including impact assessment, UAT coordination, deployment, and hypercare. Maintain system governance, documentation, compliance, and audit readiness. Support contingent workforce reporting and analytics, including headcount, spend, vendor performance, and compliance metrics. Ensure reporting and dashboards are accurate, timely, and aligned with business needs. We're looking for someone who 5+ years of experience in HR Technology / HR Systems. 1–3+ years of hands-on experience with VNDLY and contingent workforce solutions. Strong knowledge of external workforce lifecycle and HR processes. Experience with HR system integrations, with Workday integration expertise preferred. Expertise in VNDLY configuration, operations, and support. Experience working in global, multi-country HR environments. Understanding of contingent workforce compliance and vendor management. Experience with AMS support models (L2/L3). Ability to translate business requirements into system solutions. Strong collaboration skills across HR, Procurement, Finance, and IT stakeholders. Strategic thinker with a proactive approach and strong problem-solving skills. Excellent communication, presentation, organization, and time management skills. Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. High level of integrity, professionalism, and analytical ability. Fluency in English required. What you'll get Alongside meaningful work and strong development, we offer a reward package that typically includes Market-competitive pay and performance related rewards Flexible ways of working Support for health, wellbeing and life outside of work Time off to rest and recharge Ongoing learning and development opportunities Specific benefits vary by location
  
  
**Why join us?**
This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!
  
  
You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.
  
  

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.

Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.
  
  
**Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?**
If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.
  
  
If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.
  
  
**Additional Information**
The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

If you are looking to join a purpose-led, people-first, company that shapes India’s supply-chains with integrity and safety,
**Blue Dart is where you belong**
. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
  
  
**Position Overview:**
The
**PDA Manager – OPS**
is responsible for leading outsourced Pickup & Delivery Associate (PDA) operations across an assigned cluster of service centres and cities within the region. The role is accountable for ensuring adequate last-mile workforce availability, vendor capability, commercial governance and operational performance to consistently deliver Blue Dart's customer service commitments.
  
  
Reporting to the Regional Last Mile capacity building, the role manages the complete outsourced PDA ecosystem including workforce planning, vendor onboarding, delivery partner deployment, productivity management, vendor performance, billing governance, commercial controls and continuous operational improvement. The incumbent works closely with Branch Operations, HR, Finance, Procurement and vendor partners to ensure optimal delivery capacity while balancing service quality, productivity and cost efficiency.
  
  
Operating within a dynamic logistics and express distribution environment, this role plays a critical part in ensuring sufficient delivery manpower, strengthening vendor partnerships, improving operational productivity and driving scalable last-mile operations across the assigned geography.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
To manage outsourced PDA operations across assigned locations by ensuring optimum workforce availability, effective vendor governance, commercial discipline, operational productivity and service excellence while driving continuous improvement, cost optimization and compliance to support Blue Dart's last-mile delivery network.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**
**Outsourced PDA Workforce Planning**

* Lead workforce planning for outsourced Pickup & Delivery Associates (PDAs) across assigned locations based on operational demand, shipment volumes and business forecasts.
* Ensure timely deployment of adequate manpower to support business growth, seasonal peaks and operational continuity.
* Drive proactive replacement planning to minimise workforce shortages and service disruptions.
* Monitor workforce productivity and optimise deployment across branches and service centres.
* Review manpower trends and recommend corrective actions to improve delivery capacity.

**Vendor Management & Governance**

* Manage end-to-end relationships with outsourced manpower vendors across assigned locations.
* Drive identification, evaluation and onboarding of new vendors to support business expansion and operational requirements.
* Conduct regular vendor performance reviews against defined service level agreements and operational KPIs.
* Ensure vendors maintain adequate manpower availability, productivity and service quality.
* Develop strong vendor partnerships focused on operational excellence and continuous improvement.

**Commercial Governance**

* Govern vendor commercial agreements including rate card implementation, revisions and compliance.
* Review and validate vendor billing, invoice accuracy and payment documentation.
* Ensure timely reconciliation of vendor invoices with approved manpower deployment and agreed commercial terms.
* Monitor outsourced manpower costs and recommend opportunities for cost optimization.
* Partner with Finance and Procurement to strengthen commercial governance and financial controls.

**Operational Performance & Service Delivery**

* Ensure adequate PDA availability to achieve delivery commitments across assigned locations.
* Monitor productivity, manpower utilization and service performance on a regular basis.
* Drive improvements in strike rate, delivery productivity and operational responsiveness.
* Support Branch Operations teams in resolving manpower shortages and operational challenges.
* Ensure outsourced manpower supports Blue Dart's service quality and customer experience standards.

**Vendor Performance & Productivity Management**

* Ensure vendor compliance with statutory labour regulations, contractual obligations and Blue Dart policies.
* Monitor KYC, documentation, statutory records and compliance requirements for outsourced workforce.
* Coordinate with HR and vendors to ensure timely completion of onboarding documentation.
* Identify operational and compliance risks associated with outsourced manpower and implement mitigation plans.
* Maintain governance standards across all outsourced workforce operations.

**Workforce Compliance & Risk Management**

* Ensure vendor compliance with statutory labour regulations, contractual obligations and Blue Dart policies.
* Monitor KYC, documentation, statutory records and compliance requirements for outsourced workforce.
* Coordinate with HR and vendors to ensure timely completion of onboarding documentation.
* Identify operational and compliance risks associated with outsourced manpower and implement mitigation plans.
* Maintain governance standards across all outsourced workforce operations.

**Continuous Improvement & Digital Enablement**

* Drive process improvements to enhance outsourced workforce productivity and operational efficiency.
* Support implementation of digital onboarding, workforce management and vendor management initiatives.
* Promote automation and technology adoption across PDA operations.
* Analyse operational trends and recommend initiatives to improve workforce planning and service performance.
* Lead continuous improvement projects focused on productivity, cost optimization and operational excellence.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Work closely with Branch Managers, Operations Managers and Regional Operations teams to ensure adequate manpower availability.
* Partner with HR, Finance and Procurement on vendor onboarding, billing governance and workforce planning.
* Coordinate with Security and Compliance teams to ensure adherence to organizational standards.
* Build collaborative relationships with vendor partners to drive operational performance.
* Support regional operational reviews by providing workforce analytics and vendor performance insights.

* Monitoring quality, productivity, responsiveness, compliance, and stakeholder feedback; providing coaching, documenting performance, and addressing employee matters
* Serving as the shift lead and subject matter expert for Executive Service Center processes, tools, policies, service standards, and escalation pathways

The Executive Service Center (ESC) team delivers integrated administrative and office experience support to Partners, Principals, and Managing Directors (PPMDs), helping enable efficient day-to-day operations across the organization. Within Enterprise Operations Xcellence (EOX), the team focuses on consistent, high-quality service delivery, operational discipline, and a seamless support experience across US and USI stakeholders. This team works in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment and partners closely with business leaders, managers, and cross-functional support teams to address evolving service needs. title: Global Compensation Specialist
description:
Job Description

**Global HR Compensation Analyst | Pune, India | Full-time**

If you are passionate about compensation analytics, data accuracy, and improving HR processes through effective analysis and automation, this could be the ideal opportunity for you.

**Your Role:**

As a Global HR Compensation Analyst, you will play an important role in the operational delivery of Vanderlande's global compensation programmes across North America, EMEA, and APAC.

You will support market benchmarking, annual merit and incentive cycles, compensation reporting, Workday-related activities, and compensation data management. By preparing and validating data, coordinating stakeholder input, and translating compensation information into clear insights, you will contribute to accurate and timely compensation decision-making. This role combines analytical rigour with a practical continuous improvement mindset. You will identify opportunities to simplify, standardise, and automate recurring processes, calculations, reporting, and documentation, helping create compensation processes that are efficient, controlled, and scalable.You will work closely with Total Rewards, HR Technology, Finance Shared Services, and HR stakeholders across different regions to ensure accurate and timely execution of global compensation activities.

**What you will do/Key Responsibilities:**

Compensation Programme Delivery & Benchmarking (35%)

* Coordinate compensation survey participation and support global benchmarking by collecting, validating, and analysing internal and external compensation data.
* Support annual merit, Short Term Incentive (STI), and Long Term Incentive (LTI) processes.
* Prepare and validate data required for annual compensation cycles.
* Coordinate stakeholder inputs and follow up with managers and HR stakeholders on deadlines and data quality.
* Support employee letter preparation for compensation and incentive programmes.
* Support the end-to-end Sales Incentive Plan process, including template preparation, target-setting inputs, evaluation, payout calculations, and letter preparation.
* Support incentive accrual processes for Company Bonus, STI, Sales Incentive Plan, and Key Account Management incentive programmes in partnership with Finance Shared Services.

Data Analysis, Reporting & Workday Support (35%)

* Prepare compensation data, reports, and insights for Total Rewards and other HR stakeholders.
* Analyse compensation data to identify trends, inconsistencies, and data quality issues.
* Translate compensation findings into clear and practical information for stakeholders.
* Support the creation and maintenance of Workday reports in collaboration with HR Technology.
* Prepare and validate Workday upload templates for merit matrices, norm salaries, incentive targets, and other compensation data.
* Ensure compensation data is accurate, complete, and appropriately validated before submission or upload.
* Create and update compensation reports in partnership with HR Technology and relevant stakeholders.

Process Improvement & Automation (20%)

* Review compensation activities and identify opportunities to simplify, standardise, and automate recurring processes, calculations, reporting, and document preparation.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, data quality, and process controls.
* Support the design, testing, and implementation of improved compensation solutions.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives involving automation, AI, and digital solutions.
* Help establish scalable and consistent compensation processes across regions.

Knowledge Management & Stakeholder Support (10%)

* Create, update, and maintain compensation knowledge articles, process descriptions, and work instructions.
* Maintain clear and accessible documentation for recurring compensation activities.
* Provide support and guidance to stakeholders on compensation processes, data requirements, and reporting.
* Collaborate effectively with Total Rewards, HR Technology, Finance Shared Services, and HR Service Delivery teams.
* Handle confidential compensation information with appropriate discretion and sound judgement.

**What you bring:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field.
* Relevant experience in Compensation, Total Rewards, HR Analytics, HR Operations, or Financial Analysis.
* Experience supporting compensation cycles, incentive programmes, salary benchmarking, or compensation reporting.
* Strong experience working with complex datasets, calculations, and data validation.
* Experience with Workday or a comparable HR system.
* Experience with process improvement or automation within an HR or financial environment.
* Experience working in an international organisation is preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
* Advanced Excel skills and confidence working with large and sensitive datasets.
* Ability to translate complex compensation data into clear and practical insights.
* Independent and structured approach, with the ability to deliver recurring activities within fixed deadlines.
* Strong continuous improvement mindset and affinity with automation, AI, and digital solutions.
* Effective stakeholder management skills across Total Rewards, HR Technology, Finance, and HR Service Delivery.
* Sound judgement when handling confidential compensation information.
* Proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

**About the Team:**

You will report to the Global HR Specialists Lead and be part of the Global HR Specialists team within Regional HR & Global Services. The team delivers specialist HR support across HR Technology, Learning, Service & Knowledge Management, and People Analytics, supporting approximately 10,000 employees across North America, EMEA, and APAC. The role is based in Pune and works closely with Total Rewards, HR Technology, Finance Shared Services, and other HR stakeholders across the regions.

**About Vanderlande:**

Vanderlande makes automated systems that handle baggage at airports and sort parcels in logistics networks around the world. At airports, our technology manages the complete bag journey—from check-in and security screening through to the reclaim belt. In parcel logistics, our systems power the networks that get packages to customers' doors. At Vanderlande, you will find the space to aspire, to grow, and to achieve something that matters, with people who bring out the best in each other.

**Website:**
www.vanderlande.com

**What we offer:**

Working at Vanderlande comes with the support and space to grow, achieve, and enjoy the journey. Here is what that looks like in practice:

* Competitive Salary Package
* 30 days of annual leave (pro-rated from the start of the financial year), including: 22 paid leave days, 8 sick/casual leave days. Applicable government holidays
* Flexible and hybrid working model that promotes work-life balance
* Access to Vanderlande Academy and a wide range of learning and development programs
* Comprehensive medical insurance coverage, including parental coverage
* Opportunities to participate in diverse Vanderlande communities, networks, and employee initiatives
* Opportunity to collaborate globally

**How we work**

We work by three values: Every day better, We care, and Team play. In practice, this means we drive customer success, lead with transparency, celebrate what we achieve together, and do what we say.

**Ready to apply?**

Are you interested in this position? Apply directly via our careers page with your CV/Resume.

**Diversity & Inclusion**

Vanderlande is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

title: Solution Lead HR
description:
**Job Purpose**

* Acts as consultant and business partner to the HR across the Air Arabia Group, providing and implementing HR technology solutions across the HRMS landscape.
* Owns end-to-end delivery and functional governance for SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central (EC) as the system-of-record, while ensuring cross-platform readiness and outcomes across integrations, automation platforms, data/analytics dependencies, and IT security/compliance requirements.
* Ensures solutions are scalable across the Group tenant and deliver measurable operational improvement and user adoption.

Key Result Responsibilities
  
  

* Leads discovery and solution definition with HR stakeholders; translates business requirements into scalable system designs, recommending standardization and simplification where required to reduce operational complexity.
* Takes functional ownership of SuccessFactors Employee Central across the Group tenant, including configuration governance and design leadership for:

+ EC Core HR processes and foundation data model
+ EC Position Management
+ MDF objects and workflows
+ Business Rules (validations/derivations/routing controls)
+ Intelligent Services (event-based automation, triggers, notifications)

* Acts as functional owner for integration outcomes; works with middleware/technical teams to validate mapping/specifications, test end-to-end, and ensure correctness of inputs/outputs in production (reconciliation, exception handling, and controlled fixes).
* Coordinates solution dependencies beyond SuccessFactors to ensure end-to-end delivery to work on supporting upstream and downstream technologies.
* Co-owns HRMS governance in coordination with the Payroll Solution Lead, ensuring strong controls and audit readiness through:

+ Access discipline and Role-Based Permissions inputs
+ Data privacy-by-design practices and evidence readiness
+ Change governance, documentation standards, and release impact readiness

* Provides project-first delivery with L3 functional support ownership for complex HRMS issues related to Core HR processes, org changes, mass updates, workflow failures, permission-related issues, and recurring data-quality problems; ensures root-cause fixes rather than repeat workarounds.

* Uses ITSM and other spolutions for support and project tracking; contributes to SLA discipline, knowledge base creation, and operational reporting.
* Provides knowledge transfer and enablement to other HRMS team members to build bench strength and reduce single points of dependency.
* Expected to deliver measurable improvements such as:


+ Stabilization of top recurring EC incidents through permanent fixes and stronger validation controls
+ Delivery of prioritized EC enhancements/automation triggers that reduce manual HR effort
+ Improved governance maturity (documentation pack, test evidence, release readiness, access discipline)
+ Reliable integration outcomes with clear reconciliation approach for critical interfaces.

**Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages)**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent; Master’s degree is preferred.
* SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central certification is required.
* Certifications in supplementary technologies relevant to HRMS delivery (e.g., SAP Integration Suite/CPI, Integration Center, APIs, Azure fundamentals, ITIL) are considered an advantage.
* PMP certification or other recognized Project/Program Management qualification is preferred.

Work Experience
  
  

* 10+ years of experience in HR technology/HRIS or enterprise application delivery, with strong functional ownership and hands-on delivery exposure in SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central (EC).
* Expert-level working knowledge of at least one additional SuccessFactors area such as Compensation/Variable Pay, Succession & Development, Onboarding 2.0, or similar talent/rewards modules (implementation or major enhancement experience preferred).
* Demonstrated ability to lead stakeholder workshops, challenge and clarify requirements, drive decisions, and deliver end-to-end outcomes across HR, IT, and shared services teams.
* Strong depth in EC configuration and governance, including MDF objects/workflows, business rules, data model discipline, and role-based permissions / controls.
* Proven experience partnering with integration teams to validate interfaces end-to-end; solid understanding of Integration Center, API concepts, mapping/validation, test cycles, and reconciliation practices.
* Experience supporting complex HR environments (multi-entity, shared services, multi-country) is preferred; aviation/airline exposure is an advantage.

 The role involves working closely with customers, HR teams, technical consultants, and project managers to translate business requirements into effective HRMS solutions.

 * Conduct discovery workshops to understand customers’ HR policies, processes, organisational structures, and reporting requirements.

* Employee master data
* Organisation structure

* Leave and attendance management
* Timesheets
* Payroll inputs and processing workflows
* Performance management
* Learning and development

 Required Qualifications and Experience
 * Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 3–8 years of experience as an HRMS/HCM Functional Consultant, Business Analyst, or HR technology professional.
* Hands\-on experience implementing or supporting HRMS, HCM, payroll, or employee\-management applications.
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end HR processes and HR best practices.
* Working knowledge of Oracle NetSuite and its functional architecture.
* Experience in requirements gathering, process mapping, solution configuration, testing, training, and post\-go\-live support.
* Ability to translate HR requirements into clear functional and technical specifications.
* Good understanding of integrations, APIs, data migration, workflows, roles, permissions, and reporting.
* Strong analytical, documentation, problem\-solving, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate with customers, developers, project managers, and cross\-functional teams.


 Preferred Qualifications
 * Experience with NetSuite SuitePeople or other NetSuite\-based HRMS applications.
* Understanding of payroll, statutory compliance, leave, attendance, and employee lifecycle processes.
* Experience implementing cloud\-based SaaS or ERP solutions.
* Knowledge of NetSuite saved searches, SuiteFlow workflows, dashboards, and reports.
* Experience working with customers across India or international markets.

 Key Competencies

* Data migration and validation
* Training and change management

title: HRIS Analyst - Oracle Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
 The HRIS Analyst \- Oracle Specialist will serve as a functional subject matter expert (SME) for the Oracle Human Resources Management System (HRMS) / Oracle Fusion HCM platform, with primary responsibility for the configuration, optimization, support, and expansion of HR technology capabilities across a multinational operating environment. This role will lead the design, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of Oracle HRMS solutions and act as a key partner to HR, IT, Payroll, and business stakeholders. The ideal candidate brings deep, hands\-on Oracle HRMS expertise and a strong track record supporting global HR processes across Core HR, Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC), Compensation, Benefits, Talent Management, Oracle Time and Labor (OTL), and related modules.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Serve as the primary functional SME for Oracle Human Resources Management System (HRMS)/Oracle Fusion HCM and provide day\-to\-day support, configuration, enhancement, and optimization across key HR modules.
* Lead system design, configuration, testing, implementation, troubleshooting, and production support activities for Oracle HRMS in a multinational environment.
* Partner with HR, Payroll, IT, and business stakeholders to gather requirements, translate business needs into scalable Oracle HRMS solutions, and recommend best\-practice system designs.
* Support and optimize Oracle HRMS modules, including Core HR, Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC), Compensation, Benefits, Talent Management, and Oracle Time and Labor (OTL).
* Research, configure, and document solutions that address global business requirements, local country requirements, and process standardization opportunities.
* Coordinate and support system upgrades, patches, releases, and enhancements, including impact assessments, test strategy, regression testing, user acceptance testing, and deployment readiness.
* Maintain system configuration, tables, security roles, workflow setup, and related controls to ensure system reliability, usability, and compliance.
* Develop, validate, and support reports, dashboards, and analytics that enable HR decision\-making and improve operational visibility.
* Ensure data integrity through audits, controls, interface monitoring, issue resolution, and process improvements.
* Train and support end users, HR Business Partners, and other stakeholders on reporting, system functionality, and process changes.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, improve user experience, and strengthen HR operational effectiveness through Oracle HRMS.


**What You Will Need**
 Education and Experience
   

  

* BA/BS in MIS, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Human Resources, or a related field preferred.
* Strong hands\-on functional expertise in Oracle Human Resources Management System (HRMS)/Oracle Fusion HCM required.
* Significant progressive HRIS experience, including hands\-on experience supporting Oracle HRMS/Fusion HCM.
* Demonstrated experience with Oracle HRMS/Fusion HCM configuration, enhancements, implementations, testing, and production support required.
* Experience supporting global or multinational HR operations and country\-specific process requirements preferred.
* Experience supporting HR and/or Payroll systems, self\-service platforms, and related integrations preferred.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**
* Deep functional expertise in Oracle HRMS/Fusion HCM configuration, workflows, security, testing, troubleshooting, system maintenance, upgrades, and release support.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle HRMS business processes across Core HR, recruiting, compensation, benefits, talent, time and labor, and payroll\-related workflows.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable, sustainable Oracle HRMS solutions with strong attention to process design and user impact.
* Experience supporting system implementations, upgrades, and large\-scale enhancements in a complex business environment.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and data validation skills, with the ability to identify root causes and resolve system and process issues effectively.
* Advanced reporting skills, including the ability to work with large data sets and complex Microsoft Excel functions; Power BI experience is a plus.
* Strong customer\-facing, consulting, and communication skills with the ability to work effectively across HR, IT, Payroll, and business teams.
* Working knowledge of data governance, privacy, and control requirements related to HR data.
* Experience in a high\-volume, transactional environment preferred.
* Oracle HRMS/Fusion HCM reporting, dashboarding, and analytics experience preferred.
* Obtain a working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality \& Environmental Management System.


**Reporting Relationships**
 The incumbent reports to a Manager, Director, or Executive level position. This position does not have any direct reports.
   

  

**About Us**
 We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.
   

  

 ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting\-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever\-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

 ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non\-work\-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.

Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

It is intended to be an accurate reflection of the principal job elements essential for making a fair decision regarding the pay structure of the job. \#ogjs

title: Senior Specialist, Payroll Implementation & Integration-1
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior Specialist, Payroll Implementation \& Integration\-1
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 The Senior Specialist, Payroll Implementation \& Integration supports strategic payroll initiatives, including mergers and acquisitions (M\&A), P\&C Modernization programs, system implementations, and process improvement efforts. This role serves as a key execution resource responsible for coordinating testing activities, validating payroll and employee data, supporting implementation readiness, and assisting with solution deployments across payroll operations.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 M\&A Integration Support
   

  

* Support payroll workstreams during mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and organizational restructures.
* Assist with payroll integration planning and execution activities.
* Coordinate employee data collection, validation, and migration activities.
* Prepare implementation documentation and integration trackers.
* Support payroll readiness assessments and integration milestones.
* Monitor project tasks, risks, issues, and action items.
* Assist in stabilization activities following acquisitions.


 P\&C Modernization Implementation Support
   

  

* Participate in payroll\-related activities supporting Workday and P\&C Modernization initiatives.
* Support configuration validation and business process testing.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to evaluate payroll impacts of system changes.
* Coordinate payroll requirements gathering and documentation.
* Support process redesign and standardization initiatives.


 Testing \& Quality Assurance
   

  

* Execute end\-to\-end payroll testing activities for system implementations and enhancements.
* Develop and assist with unit testing, system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), parallel payroll testing, regression testing
* Validate payroll calculations and outputs.
* Reconcile testing results and identify variances.
* Document, track, and help resolve defects.
* Verify successful implementation of payroll requirements.


 Process Improvement \& Documentation
   

  

* Create and maintain standard test scripts, process documentation, standard operating procedures
* Identify opportunities to improve payroll processes and implementation methodologies.
* Contribute to payroll implementation playbooks and best practices.
* Support operational readiness reviews.


 Vendor \& Stakeholder Coordination
   

  

* Collaborate with Payroll Operations, P\&C teams, Benefits, Technology teams, Third\-party payroll providers
* Participate in project meetings and provide implementation status updates.
* Escalate risks, issues, and testing concerns as necessary.
* Support communication and change management activities.


 Post\-Go\-Live Stabilization
   

  

* Assist with issue resolution following implementations.
* Monitor payroll processing and implementation outcomes.
* Validate corrective actions and system fixes.
* Transition completed solutions to operational payroll teams.


**Qualifications**
* 3–5 years of payroll, payroll implementation, or payroll operations experience.
* Experience supporting payroll system implementations or upgrades.
* Understanding of payroll processes, controls, and compliance requirements.
* Experience with testing methodologies and issue management.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Advanced Excel and data analysis capabilities.
* Experience supporting M\&A integrations.
* Experience with Workday, ADP, or other payroll platforms.
* Experience participating in large\-scale HR or payroll transformation programs.
* Knowledge of payroll compliance, tax, benefits, and time management processes.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

* Create, update, and maintain SOPs, process maps, and workflow documentation across all HRIS processes.

* Support communication and training efforts for global system enhancements.
